title: Data Scientist
description:
Matrix IFS is looking for a Data Scientist, the job involves working with client data to develop and implement fraud detection models, which includes data cleaning, feature engineering, and model tuning. Responsibilities also include collaborating with clients and internal teams, communicating findings, and contributing to product development by creating scalable data pipelines and improving processes.

Key skills required are proficiency in Python (including libraries like NumPy, Pandas, and scikit-learn), machine learning, distributed computing (like PySpark), and strong communication abilities.

Core responsibilities

  • Data analysis and modeling: Understand client data, perform data cleaning and preprocessing, and develop and tune machine learning models.
  • Collaboration: Work with internal teams (Product, Research) and external stakeholders (clients) to understand business objectives and ensure client success.
  • Technical leadership: Provide technical guidance, drive project execution, and contribute to building scalable data pipelines and prototypes.
  • Product development: Help improve the product by contributing to solution development, keeping up with fraud prevention trends, and creating generalized product enhancements.
  • Communication: Clearly communicate complex findings and strategies to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Key skills and qualifications

  • Programming: Strong proficiency in Python, including scientific stack libraries (NumPy, Pandas, SciPy, scikit-learn) and experience with distributed computing tools like PySpark.
  • Machine Learning: Expertise in machine learning concepts and algorithms.
  • Data Manipulation: Experience with data cleaning, feature engineering, and building scalable data pipelines (e.g., with Airflow and Trino).
  • Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills to explain complex ideas to various stakeholders.
  • Analytical: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills to tackle complex financial crime challenges.

Education: A degree in a quantitative field like Computer Science, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, or a related area is often required.

Why Matrix

Matrix is a global, dynamic, fast-growing technical consultancy leading technology services company with 13000 employees worldwide. Since its foundation in 2001, Matrix has made more travelers and acquisitions and has executed some of the largest, most significant. The company specializes in implementing and developing leading technologies, software solutions, and products. It provides its customers with infrastructure and consulting services, IT outsourcing, offshore, training and assimilation, and Ves as representatives for the world's leading software vendors. With vast experience in private and public sectors, ranging from Finance, Telecom, Health, Hi-Tech, Education, Defense, and Secu city, Matrix's customer base includes guest organizations in Israel and a steadily growing client base worldwide.

We are comprised of talented, creative, and dedicated individuals passionate about delivering innovative solutions to the market. We source and foster the best talent and recognize that all employee's contributions are integral to our company's future.

Matrix- success is based on a challenging work environment, competitive compensation and benefits, and rewarding career opportunities. We encourage a diverse work environment of sharing, learning, and ceding together. Come and join the winning team! You'll be challenged and have fun in a highly respected organization. To Learn More, Visit Matrix -ifs. Com,

title: Field Representative
description:
Sobre a vaga


Título da vaga: Representante de Coleta de Dados em Campo

Tipo de vaga: Regular, período integral. De segunda a sexta-feira

Período do contrato: 10 dias úteis (incluindo treinamento) – Temporário

Local: Brasília, Brasil

Descrição da vaga:

A Aceolution está contratando com urgência Representantes de Coleta de Dados em Campo em Taipei, Taiwan, para verificar pontos de interesse (POI) com base em instruções específicas de pesquisa. Isso envolverá deslocamentos a pé até os locais designados.


No entanto, os participantes podem usar bicicletas/patinetes/outros meios de transporte, se desejarem.


Natureza do trabalho:

Verificação a pé de POIs (Pontos de Interesse), que podem incluir hotéis, postos de gasolina, restaurantes e estabelecimentos similares.


Iremos fornecer:

Uma lista de instalações a serem verificadas + uma camada de pontos com as localizações

Instruções para a pesquisa

Aplicativo móvel (Android/iOS) compatível com Android 10 e iOS

O pesquisador precisará se deslocar até o Ponto de Interesse (POI) e verificar/coletar algumas informações, que podem envolver de 5 a 10 parâmetros, além de tirar uma foto da placa e da entrada principal.


Recomendamos a coleta a pé; no entanto, os pesquisadores podem usar bicicleta, patinete ou outro meio de transporte, se preferirem.


Requisitos:

Residir em Brasília ou arredores, Brasil

Proficiência em inglês (leitura e conversação)

Capacidade de se deslocar a pé ou utilizar transporte para verificar o POI (Ponto de Interesse)



Job Title: Field Data Representative

Employment Type: Regular, full-time. Monday to Friday

Contract period: 10 Days work include training

Location: Brasília, Brazil.


Job Description:

Aceolution is urgently hiring Field Data Representatives in Águas Claras, Federal District, Brazil to verify points of interest (POI) based on specific survey instructions. This will involve walking in assigned locations.

However, workers are free to use bike/scooter/other transport if he wants.


Nature of work:

Pedestrian verification of POIs (Point of Interest) which can be amongst hotels, gas stations, restaurants and the likes. We’ll provide: - The list of facilities to verify + the point layer with locations - Survey instructions - Mobile app (Android/iOS) that works on Android 10 and iOS The surveyor will need to walk to the POI and check/collect some information that may involve 5-10 parameters about it and take a picture of the entrance. We recommend on-feet collection; however, workers are free to use bike/scooter/other transport if he/she wants.


Requirements:

  • Must live in or near to Brasília, Brazil
  • English proficiency (read and speak)
  • Ability to walk or use other means of transport for POI verification

Location: Brasília, Brazil.


Job Description:

Aceolution is urgently hiring Field Data Representatives in Águas Claras, Federal District, Brazil to verify points of interest (POI) based on specific survey instructions. This will involve walking in assigned locations.

However, workers are free to use bike/scooter/other transport if he wants.


Nature of work:

Pedestrian verification of POIs (Point of Interest) which can be amongst hotels, gas stations, restaurants and the likes. We’ll provide: - The list of facilities to verify + the point layer with locations - Survey instructions - Mobile app (Android/iOS) that works on Android 10 and iOS The surveyor will need to walk to the POI and check/collect some information that may involve 5-10 parameters about it and take a picture of the entrance. We recommend on-feet collection; however, workers are free to use bike/scooter/other transport if he/she wants.


Requirements:

  • Must live in or near to Brasília, Brazil
  • English proficiency (read and speak)
  • Ability to walk or use other means of transport for POI verification

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
As a Software Engineer , you will work closely with the product owner to shape the implementation of new features/sites. You will collaborate with the PO to write, refine, groom, and plan stories for feature implementation. You will also work with other teams when there are cross-team impacts to ensure integration is seamless and efficient.



Responsibilities

• Technical design and analysis of business use cases in preparation for development.

• Work well in Agile or Lean Software Development Life Cycle.

• Follow InComm standards and best practices, for logging, code review

• Manage and maintain lower environments (QA, UAT, Staging)

• Support production deployments

• Assist with production support, on-call schedule for DEV resources.

• Automate processes through SDLC to permit speed of delivery

• Ensure appropriate monitoring and alerting is in place prior to production deployments.

• Technical design and analysis of business use cases in preparation for development

• Able to quickly adjust and support changing priorities per business needs.

• Provide unit testing to ensure quality of builds in a continuous integration environment.

• Engage in production deployment co-ordination and verification

• Create documentation on the existing system and maintain documentation which includes current state of system flow, sequence diagrams, architecture diagrams, runbooks

• Participate in the full lifecycle of projects, including effective use of version control, build management, unit testing, and issue tracking software

• Effective verbal and written communication

• Problem solving skills and the ability to work with innovative solutions

• Strong analytical skills with the ability to assess complex situations and understand key issues quickly

• Ability to adapt in a dynamic work environment and make independent decisions while keeping management informed

• Work effectively in a team environment to produce good quality and timely results

• Able to work under tight deadlines while providing high-quality work

• Parse, analyze and understand system log files

• Customer Service orientation with the ability to effectively interact with users of all levels

• Able to proactively address system issues that have potential impact for the corporation

• Strong research, analytical, and troubleshooting skills

• Check and verify the applications are running and functioning properly after system updates

• Migration of platforms and application components.

• Support after-hours coverage/escalation & support on-call rotation


Qualifications

• Technologist, Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree

• At least 7 years of Software Development experience

• Experience with the full lifecycle of software development including use of version control tools, build management, unit testing, issue tracking software (e.g. SVN, Maven, Microsoft Visual Studio, JIRA)

• Java 17+

• Spring (data, boot, security, batch and actuator)

• In memory caching like Hazelcast

• Oracle 12c

• XML, JSON

• Hibernate, Hibernate/JPA

• REST Services

• API Management frameworks

• General SQL/Database experience, MS-SQL, Oracle

• Jenkins, Sonar

• JIRA & Confluence

• Strong analytical skills with the ability to assess complex systems and situations and troubleshoot issues

• Problem solving skills, critical thinking and strong decision-making skills

• Excellent verbal and written communication, and interpersonal interactions (ability to foster a cooperative work environment)

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Full Stack Engineer - Opportunity in Brazil (100% remote)


Location: Fully Remote

Contract: PJ (open-ended)


About the Role

One of our US-based clients is looking for a kind, curious, and collaborative Senior Software Engineer (Full Stack) who enjoys solving complex and meaningful problems.

This team is responsible for building seamless and compelling experiences that make it easy for individuals to consign luxury items. We place a strong emphasis on personal growth, technical excellence, and a highly collaborative engineering culture.

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will be a hands-on contributor while also influencing technical direction. You will lead impactful initiatives, participate in architectural decisions, and provide mentorship through thoughtful code reviews and pair programming.

If you are excited about luxury retail, e-commerce, or sustainability—and passionate about contributing to a circular economy for high-end goods—this role is for you.


What You’ll Do

  • Build high-quality, performant, and testable code that supports company-wide initiatives
  • Develop with modern technologies including Elixir, Ruby, React, TypeScript, GraphQL, Kafka, AWS (Lambda), PostgreSQL, and DynamoDB
  • Contribute to architectural and technical decisions shaping the future of our systems
  • Review pull requests and provide constructive, actionable feedback
  • Collaborate through pair programming and team-based feature development
  • Deploy user-facing features to production
  • Continuously learn and introduce new patterns, tools, and improvements


Required Skills & Experience

  • 5+ years of professional software development experience
  • Fluency in Elixir or Ruby
  • Strong proficiency in modern JavaScript (ECMAScript) , HTML, and CSS
  • Experience with React and the broader React ecosystem (Node.js, npm)
  • Experience working with RESTful APIs
  • Proficiency with Git and version control workflows
  • Familiarity with TypeScript
  • Understanding of event-based architectures
  • Strong database fundamentals
  • Experience working with GraphQL
  • Enthusiasm for solving user-centric problems with technology


Desired Skills

  • Experience with Kafka for event streaming
  • Experience extracting or building microservices from a monolithic architecture
  • Interest in luxury retail, e-commerce, or high-end consignment markets
  • Passion for sustainability and circular economy initiatives


Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field preferred
  • Equivalent professional experience considered

title: Líder Técnico Pleno (Node.JS / React)
description:
O Inatel está recrutando profissionais para atuação na liderança técnica de projetos de software no Inatel Competence Center - PDI SW.

Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Liderar tecnicamente times e projetos de desenvolvimento de software;
  • Propor soluções que atendam ao negócio e sejam escaláveis, possuem protocolos de comunicação, regras de negócios e integração com equipamentos;
  • Elaborar documentação técnica do projeto, operacionais e de apoio à gerência;
  • Definir e documentar arquitetura lógica e executável de sistemas;
  • Realizar a especificação funcional de projetos;
  • Prover suporte ao time de QA;
  • Revisar código desenvolvido conforme boas práticas da tecnologia;
  • Projetar software para integração e entrega contínua;
  • Prover capacitação, orientação e suporte técnico aos desenvolvedores.


Requisitos e qualificações

Ensino Superior Completo na área de tecnologia, preferencialmente em cursos de Computação, Engenharia, Sistemas de Informação ou Ciência da Computação;


Experiências em:

  • Desenvolvimento de soluções NodeJS ou .NET Core,
  • Angular e/ou React,
  • APIs Rest,
  • Arquitetura de soluções em cloud,
  • Arquitetura de microserviços,
  • Banco de dados não relacional/relacional,
  • Cultura DevOps,
  • Uso de ferramentas de design UX/UI,
  • Metodologias de desenvolvimento ágeis.


Domínio em:

  • Modelagem de projetos,
  • Ferramentas de análise de código e de controle de versionamento de código.


Conhecimento em:

  • Design patterns,
  • Desenvolvimento de aplicativo móvel,
  • Testes automatizados.


Seria interessante se você tivesse:


  • Capacidade de organização com múltiplas atividades e requisições simultâneas;
  • Capacidade de aprendizado e disseminação de conhecimento;
  • Inglês intermediário.


Informações adicionais

Horário de Trabalho: Segunda à sexta, das 08h às 12h e das 13h30 às 17h30.


Local de Trabalho: As atividades serão realizadas em regime de Teletrabalho \"Home Office\".

title: UI/UX Designer
description:
UI/UX Designer

Full-Time | Brazil (Hybrid) | Mid–Senior Level


About the Role

We build technology products for companies that are reshaping how industries operate. Our design team sits at the intersection of product strategy, engineering, and user research, and the work we do ships to real users.


This is not a purely visual design role. Designers here influence product direction, collaborate closely with engineers and product leaders, and help define how complex systems should actually work.


We are looking for a UI/UX Designer who can move fluidly between ambiguous discovery work and pixel-precise execution. You will partner with product managers, engineers, and client stakeholders to design experiences that are strategically sound and deeply usable.


What You'll Do

• Own design end-to-end for one or more product workstreams, from research and wireframes through final developer handoff

• Facilitate discovery sessions with clients and internal teams to clarify problems before jumping into solutions

• Produce high-fidelity prototypes and detailed design specifications that engineers can build from with minimal iteration

• Conduct usability testing and translate insights into actionable design improvements

• Contribute to and help maintain shared design systems across multiple products

• Present design rationale clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, including client leadership

• Collaborate with product managers to define success metrics for design decisions and evaluate outcomes after launch

What We're Looking For


Must-Have Experience

• 3+ years of product design experience, ideally within a startup, consultancy, or fast-paced product environment

• Strong portfolio demonstrating systems thinking and problem solving, not just visual design

• Advanced proficiency with Figma including components, auto-layout, variables, and interactive prototyping

• Experience designing for both web and mobile platforms with awareness of technical constraints

• Ability to communicate design decisions in terms of user impact and business value

• Comfortable working in ambiguous environments where problems are not fully defined


Nice to Have

• Experience designing products for enterprise or B2B users

• Familiarity with front-end development concepts such as HTML, CSS, or React fundamentals

• Experience with service design or end-to-end journey mapping for complex products

• Experience building or scaling a design system from the ground up


How We Work

Our teams operate in short delivery cycles with tight collaboration between design, product, and engineering. We prioritize fast decision making, direct communication, and high ownership.


We partner with organizations across industries including healthcare, financial services, logistics, and enterprise software. Projects range from building new products from scratch to modernizing complex legacy platforms.


What You'll Get

• Competitive base salary with performance-based compensation

• Comprehensive health, dental, and vision benefits

• Flexible remote-first environment with optional in-person collaboration

• Exposure to a wide range of industries and product challenges

• A design-focused team that values craft and pushes each other to produce exceptional work

Full-Time | Brazil (Hybrid) | Mid–Senior Level


About the Role

We build technology products for companies that are reshaping how industries operate. Our design team sits at the intersection of product strategy, engineering, and user research, and the work we do ships to real users.


This is not a purely visual design role. Designers here influence product direction, collaborate closely with engineers and product leaders, and help define how complex systems should actually work.


We are looking for a UI/UX Designer who can move fluidly between ambiguous discovery work and pixel-precise execution. You will partner with product managers, engineers, and client stakeholders to design experiences that are strategically sound and deeply usable.


What You'll Do

• Own design end-to-end for one or more product workstreams, from research and wireframes through final developer handoff

• Facilitate discovery sessions with clients and internal teams to clarify problems before jumping into solutions

• Produce high-fidelity prototypes and detailed design specifications that engineers can build from with minimal iteration

• Conduct usability testing and translate insights into actionable design improvements

• Contribute to and help maintain shared design systems across multiple products

• Present design rationale clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, including client leadership

• Collaborate with product managers to define success metrics for design decisions and evaluate outcomes after launch

What We're Looking For


Must-Have Experience

• 3+ years of product design experience, ideally within a startup, consultancy, or fast-paced product environment

• Strong portfolio demonstrating systems thinking and problem solving, not just visual design

• Advanced proficiency with Figma including components, auto-layout, variables, and interactive prototyping

• Experience designing for both web and mobile platforms with awareness of technical constraints

• Ability to communicate design decisions in terms of user impact and business value

• Comfortable working in ambiguous environments where problems are not fully defined


Nice to Have

• Experience designing products for enterprise or B2B users

• Familiarity with front-end development concepts such as HTML, CSS, or React fundamentals

• Experience with service design or end-to-end journey mapping for complex products

• Experience building or scaling a design system from the ground up


How We Work

Our teams operate in short delivery cycles with tight collaboration between design, product, and engineering. We prioritize fast decision making, direct communication, and high ownership.


We partner with organizations across industries including healthcare, financial services, logistics, and enterprise software. Projects range from building new products from scratch to modernizing complex legacy platforms.


What You'll Get

• Competitive base salary with performance-based compensation

• Comprehensive health, dental, and vision benefits

• Flexible remote-first environment with optional in-person collaboration

• Exposure to a wide range of industries and product challenges

• A design-focused team that values craft and pushes each other to produce exceptional work

title: Automotive Release Manager
description:
Before you apply, please get familiar with Luxoft:


  • Luxoft locations:
  • Logeek Magazine:
  • Luxoft Alumni Club:



Mandatory Skills Description:


  • Product & Delivery Execution
  • Proven experience in Product Owner, Technical Program Manager, Delivery Lead or Release Engineer roles
  • Strong ability to manage end-to-end delivery in a complex, cross-functional environment
  • Experience managing multiple release timelines
  • Hands-on experience with backlog management, refinement, and sprint execution
  • Ability to sequence and coordinate work within agreed priorities
  • Quality & Compliance Mindset
  • Experience working with quality-critical or compliance-driven requirements
  • Strong attention to detail and traceability (requirements → implementation → validation)
  • Ability to manage high-risk changes where small defects can have large impact
  • Release & Operational Skills
  • Experience coordinating software releases end to end
  • Ability to track release readiness, risks, and regressions
  • Comfort working with production or preproduction environments (e.g. test benches)
  • Tools & Ways of Working
  • Experience working with distributed or nearshore teams
  • Strong hands-on experience with Jira and Confluence
  • Solid understanding of agile software development (Scrum, SAFe)
  • Ability to operate independently with limited guidance
  • Stakeholder & Pressure Handling
  • Proven ability to work with hands-off stakeholders who escalate under failure
  • Strong communication skills: clear, calm, and structured under pressure
  • Ability to anticipate issues, surface risks early, and drive resolution
  • Good judgment in knowing when to act independently vs when to escalate


Project Description:


  • This role coordinates delivery and releases for an in-car accessibility product within an Android-based infotainment system, with a primary focus on meeting legal and regulatory accessibility requirements.
  • Core responsibilities include ensuring compliance, traceability, and correct implementation of accessibility-related changes, while driving quality improvements, defect resolution, and predictable, disciplined releases. Occasional support for new feature development is also expected.
  • Due to the nature of accessibility work, even small changes can have significant user and legal impact, making precision, validation, and strong execution essential. The role operates in a highly complex stakeholder environment, where stakeholders are typically hands-off during day-to-day execution but become highly involved and escalatory when issues arise. Successfully navigating these situations—through transparency, risk anticipation, sound judgment, and resolution under pressure—is a critical aspect of the role.
  • The role works closely with a small team of Android developers. The exact split of responsibilities will be defined once the new hire is onboarded, allowing flexibility based on individual strengths, experience, and evolving product and delivery needs.


Responsibilities:


  • Product & Backlog Management
  • Manage and maintain the product backlog in Jira, with a primary focus on accessibility-related bug
  • fixes, improvements, and release work
  • Support new accessibility features by preparing, refining, and tracking requirements and acceptance
  • criteria with stakeholder
  • Clarify functional, UX, and accessibility requirements with stakeholders and engineering
  • Ensure backlog items are well-defined, testable, and ready for implementation
  • Sprint, PI & Delivery Execution
  • Plan and facilitate sprint and PI activities with the development team
  • Coordinate sprint planning, reviews, retrospectives, and execution tracking
  • Monitor progress, dependencies, and risks across sprints and PIs
  • Sequence and balance work within agreed priorities and constraints to support timely delivery
  • Accessibility, Quality & Change Coordination
  • Coordinate defect fixes, accessibility improvements, and change requests
  • Assess and document impacts, dependencies, and delivery risks, especially where accessibility or compliance may be affected
  • Highlight trade-offs and potential impacts early and transparently
  • Escalate complex or high-impact topics to the appropriate stakeholders
  • Release & Operational Ownership
  • Coordinate end-to-end release activities, including readiness tracking, validation status, and
  • communication
  • Support CI/CD, build, test, and deployment processes in collaboration with engineering
  • Track release quality, regression risks, and production issues
  • Coordinate verification activities on test benches and organize debugging sessions when required
  • Management of test specifications (update existing test specifications if required, create test runs for
  • external testers, etc.)
  • Stakeholder Communication
  • Represent the team and topic in stakeholder meetings, like calls with VW Group brands or
  • representatives of legal and regulatory departments
  • Act as the primary coordination point for day-to-day delivery and release topics
  • Communicate progress, risks, and release status clearly and consistently
  • Support alignment between product, UX, engineering, and validation stakeholders

title: Junior Recruiter
description:
International Assistant Recruiter - Fluent in English | Remote


At Bluedot BPO Solutions , we connect top LATAM talent with high-performing U.S. teams. We are looking for a highly organized and proactive Recruiter Assistant with strong English skills to support high-volume recruiting operations.


This fully remote role offers daily exposure to the U.S. market and a clear growth path for professionals who want to build an international career in recruitment.


What We Offer

  • Fixed compensation of R$3,500
  • 100% remote , working directly with U.S. recruiting teams
  • Monday to Friday, 12 PM – 21 PM (BRT)
  • Long-term position
  • Fast-track growth opportunities (Executive Recruiting, Leadership, Management)
  • International exposure and multicultural environment
  • Paid training and structured onboarding


Your Responsibilities

  • Support sourcing and pre-qualification of candidates for U.S. clients
  • Conduct initial screenings via calls, emails, and messages
  • Maintain updated databases (ATS and job boards)
  • Draft and update job descriptions and candidate profiles
  • Source talent through job boards and resume databases
  • Manage calendars and candidate–recruiter communication flow
  • Assist with administrative recruitment tasks


What We’re Looking For

  • Advanced English (C1) — strong written and spoken communication
  • 3+ months of experience in recruitment
  • Highly organized and able to manage multiple priorities
  • Detail-oriented, proactive, and delivery-focused
  • Comfortable in fast-paced environments


Nice to Have

  • Previous experience in Recruitment or Talent Acquisition
  • Familiarity with LinkedIn Recruiter, Dynamics, or other ATS
  • Experience in high-volume recruiting environments


Technical Requirements

  • Two monitors
  • Laptop with i5/i7 (or equivalent) + 12GB RAM
  • High-speed internet
  • Headset with microphone
  • Quiet home office


Build your international career in Recruitment.

Work directly with U.S. teams and grow in a structured, high-performance environment.

title: Analista de DP Pl.
description:
Olá, Cobasilovers!

Você tem paixão por todas as formas de vida, seja ela plantas, animais ou pessoas? Gosta da ideia de ser um mediador de afeto entre elas?

Estamos com uma oportunidade para atuar como Analista de DP Pl .

Se você é apaixonado(a) por animais, plantas, pessoas, processos e projetos aqui é o seu lugar!


Principais Atividades:

  • Realizar o cálculo da rescisão de colaboradores no sistema RM labore.
  • Conferir e processar as rescisões e FGTS digital.
  • Gerar e transmitir obrigações como e-social e FGTS digital.
  • Controlar e acompanhar as solicitações de desligamentos.
  • Atender os gestores para esclarecimento de dúvidas.
  • Garantir o cumprimento da legislação trabalhista e das normas internas da empresa.
  • Manter o sistema RM labore atualizado, tendo um olhar estratégico para automatizações e melhoria de processos.


Requisitos:

  • Ensino superior completo em Administração, Recursos Humanos, Contabilidade ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência na função, com domínio das rotinas de departamento pessoal.
  • Conhecimento da legislação trabalhista.
  • Domínio de sistemas de folha de pagamento RM Labore (diferencial), eSocial e FGTS digital.
  • Pacote Office intermediário (especialmente Excel).
  • Conhecimento em fórmulas de Excel, para conferência dos eventos através de relatórios;


Oferecemos

  • VR/VA no valor de 961,00 reais com flexibilidade de escolha;
  • Refeitório no local;
  • Café da manhã com frutas;
  • Assistência Médica e Odontológica Amil;
  • Day Off;
  • Ambiente Pet Friendly;
  • Cartão Ticket Plus;
  • Wellhub (Convênio com Academias);
  • Wellz (Plataforma online para cuidado, bem estar e saúde mental);
  • Convênio com o Sesc e Senac.


Local de trabalho: Vila Leopoldina - Próximo ao parque Villa Lobos.

title: React/Retool Developer
description:
My US client is looking to expand their development team in Brazil. They are seeking a React Developer to work on their CMS solution. They are looking for a motivated developer with solid React experience and basic SQL skills to build and maintain internal tools using Retool. This role requires someone who can work independently, solve problems effectively, and communicate clearly in English.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop and maintain internal applications using Retool and React.
  • Write and optimize basic SQL queries, functions, and stored procedures.
  • Perform simple data extraction and analysis from relational databases.
  • Collaborate with product and technical stakeholders to understand requirements.
  • Troubleshoot issues, identify root causes, and propose effective solutions.
  • Deliver features with minimal supervision and manage tasks independently.
  • Maintain clean, readable, and maintainable code.


Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Software Engineering, or equivalent experience.
  • Solid experience with React (components, hooks, state management).
  • Basic to intermediate knowledge of SQL databases:
  • Writing queries (SELECT, JOIN, WHERE, GROUP BY)
  • Creating simple functions and procedures
  • Performing data extraction
  • Ability to work independently with limited assistance.
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
  • Self-motivated, proactive, and accountable.
  • Proficient English communication skills (written and verbal).


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Previous experience with Retool or other low-code/internal tools platforms.
  • Experience working with APIs (REST).
  • Familiarity with Git and basic development workflows.
  • Experience working with internal business tools or dashboards.


This role is CLT and remote in Brazil. Target compenstation is R$10,000 per month

title: Oracle EBS Developer
description:
Job Title: Technical Consultant – Oracle EBS R12 (FRICEW)

Job Type- Contract

Location- Remote 100%

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced Technical Consultant with strong hands-on experience in Oracle E-Business Suite R12. The candidate should have solid experience working on FRICEW components (Forms, Reports, Integrations, Conversions, Enhancements, Workflow) and strong PL/SQL skills.


Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and customize Oracle EBS R12 objects.
  • Work on FRICEW components:
  • Forms customization
  • Reports (XML/BI Publisher, Oracle Reports)
  • Integrations (inbound & outbound interfaces)
  • Data conversions
  • Enhancements
  • Workflow development
  • Develop and support PL/SQL packages, procedures, and triggers.
  • Create and maintain technical design documents (TDD).
  • Work closely with functional consultants and business users.
  • Support testing, deployment, and production issues.


Required Skills

  • 4+ years of experience in Oracle EBS R12.
  • Strong experience in FRICEW development.
  • Excellent PL/SQL and SQL knowledge.
  • Experience with XML Publisher / BI Publisher.
  • Knowledge of APIs, Interface Tables, and Concurrent Programs.
  • Experience in Workflow customization.
  • Basic Unix shell scripting knowledge.


Preferred Skills

  • Implementation or upgrade project experience.
  • Knowledge of Finance or SCM modules.
  • Good communication and documentation skills.

Ao se juntar à Stefanini, você se torna parte de uma jornada global de transformação. Estamos empenhados em criar impacto positivo não apenas nos negócios, mas também na vida de nossos colaboradores. Se você procura uma oportunidade de crescimento profissional em uma empresa que valoriza inovação, respeito, autonomia e parceria, você encontra aqui!


Junte-se a nós e seja parte da mudança!


Estamos em busca de um(a) Desenvolvimento e Programação Especialista (DEVES) para se juntar ao nosso time. Este profissional será responsável por desenvolver, evoluir e sustentar integrações em IBM ACE, garantindo alta disponibilidade e performance. Além disso, irá projetar e implementar APIs e serviços SOA, seguindo padrões corporativos de arquitetura e conduzir iniciativas de modernização de integrações, reduzindo acoplamento e aumentando escalabilidade. - Experiência comprovada em desenvolvimento e sustentação de APIs corporativas, incluindo versionamento, segurança e governança.

- Vivência em modernização de integrações legadas, migrando soluções monolíticas ou ESB tradicionais para arquiteturas mais modernas.

- Experiência prática com Java e/ou Go aplicados a integrações e serviços.

- Conhecimento em Cloud (AWS, Azure ou GCP) e conceitos de containerização (Docker, Kubernetes).

title: ServiceNow Applications Engineer
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


Sobre a posição

Estamos em busca de um(a) ServiceNow Applications Engineer com forte expertise em AppEngine , desenvolvimento de aplicações customizadas e automação de processos, para atuar em um ambiente altamente técnico e colaborativo.

O(a) profissional será responsável por liderar iniciativas de desenvolvimento, governança de plataforma e soluções de automação industrial, combinando visão estratégica, excelência técnica e interação com múltiplas áreas do negócio.


Principais Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver aplicações e workflows customizados em ServiceNow (AppEngine, Flow Designer, IntegrationHub)
  • Projetar soluções escaláveis, seguras e aderentes às melhores práticas da plataforma
  • Integrar ServiceNow com sistemas externos via REST/SOAP
  • Criar e manter Script Includes, Business Rules, ACLs e UI Policies
  • Orientar desenvolvedores juniores e plenos, incluindo code reviews e mentoring
  • Garantir governança da plataforma, reusabilidade e qualidade técnica das entregas
  • Desenvolver e sustentar aplicações de processo e automação industrial, utilizando tecnologias de Controle Avançado e Otimizadores em tempo real
  • Participar de projetos estratégicos, atuando como referência técnica e colaborando em melhorias cross-funcionais


Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Inglês avançado/fluente
  • Experiência sólida com:
  • JavaScript e Glide API
  • ServiceNow AppEngine
  • Flow Designer
  • Script Includes, Business Rules, ACLs, UI Policies
  • Integrações via REST/SOAP
  • Experiência com HRSD, S2P e outros módulos/plugins ServiceNow
  • Vivência com DevOps, ATF e GitHub
  • Experiência em automação industrial / controle de processos
  • Conhecimento em tecnologias de refino e processos químicos
  • Experiência com Multivariable Predictive Control (AspenTech DMC, Honeywell RMPCT)
  • Experiência com Real-Time Optimizers (RoMeo ou similares)


Diferenciais

  • Certificações ServiceNow:
  • Flow Designer
  • IntegrationHub
  • Automated Test Framework
  • Service Portal
  • Performance Analytics
  • CSA (Certified System Administrator)
  • CAD (Certified Application Developer)
  • CIS (Certified Implementation Specialist)
  • CTA (Certified Technical Architect)


Onde você vai trabalhar?

100% remoto. No conforto de sua casa.

title: Research Engineer, Coding Agents
description:
About Turing

Turing builds large-scale datasets and reinforcement learning (RL) environments that power post-training for the world's leading AI labs and enterprises, including OpenAI, Anthropic, Google DeepMind, Microsoft AI, Amazon, Apple, and many more. We create RL environments to evaluate and improve our customers' models on complex, multi-step workflows across high-value domains — designing the tasks, reward signals, and verifiers that drive measurable model improvement through RL training.


The Role

We are looking for a Research Engineer, Coding Agents to help deliver frontier-quality datasets, RL environments, and evaluations that improve state-of-the-art coding models and software engineering agents for leading AI labs and enterprise clients.

This is a hands-on, research-facing technical role. You will work directly with customer researchers and engineers to turn their coding agent improvement goals into concrete data and environment specs — designing tasks that reflect real software engineering work and building the ground-truth systems that verify agent performance.


We're targeting candidates with roughly 4–5 years of experience, ideally combining strong software engineering fundamentals with exposure to ML/AI systems — especially where results depended on data quality, evaluation rigor, or building infrastructure that other engineers rely on.


What You'll Do:

1. Design and deliver datasets and RL environments for coding agents

  • Work with customer researchers to define data requirements for coding agent capabilities: codebase navigation, bug localization, patching, test generation, code reviews, CI-like constraints, refactors, and security fixes.
  • Design task suites that reflect real development work — single-step tasks (fix this bug, write this test) through long-horizon workflows (navigate an unfamiliar repo, diagnose a multi-file issue, produce a reviewed PR).
  • Build ground-truth signals: unit tests, structured checks, automatic validators, and reward functions that verify whether an agent's code actually works.
  • Define environment interfaces — repository structures, dependency contexts, tool schemas — that give agents realistic constraints.


2. Build the quality and validation systems that ensure frontier-grade data

  • Perform deep, detail-oriented audits of produced data — spotting subtle errors, reward hacking opportunities (e.g., agents gaming test suites), leakage, and inconsistent assumptions.
  • Implement automated validation and filtering: deduplication, decontamination, consistency checks, and difficulty/diversity controls.
  • Where appropriate, develop synthetic task generation pipelines: programmatic bug injection, controlled perturbations to existing codebases, and scenario templating across languages and frameworks.


3. Prove impact through evaluations and training runs

  • Design and run evals aligned with coding benchmarks and customer-defined capability targets.
  • Produce analysis connecting data to outcomes: pre/post comparisons on targeted coding tasks, error breakdowns, and ablations identifying which data attributes drive model lift on SWE tasks.
  • When needed, run fine-tuning or RL experiments (or partner with research) to demonstrate measurable coding agent improvement.


4. Collaborate with cross-functional delivery teams

  • Provide clear specs, examples, and edge cases to engineers, QAs, and large-scale data production groups.
  • Run fast feedback loops grounded in code quality metrics and automated signals.
  • Review and improve outputs from large-scale task creation efforts, maintaining a high bar for realism and correctness.


Who We're Looking For:

1. Required Qualifications

  • 4–5 years of professional software engineering or ML engineering experience.
  • Python proficiency required; proficiency in one or more additional major languages (C++, Java, Go, Rust, JS/TS) strongly preferred.
  • Strong intuition for what makes a good coding task — realistic difficulty, clear ground truth, and resistance to shortcut solutions.
  • Demonstrated ability to be extremely detail-oriented: you catch bugs in code that automated tools miss.
  • Experience with testing infrastructure, CI/CD, or code quality systems at a meaningful scale.
  • Ability to communicate clearly with researchers and engineers — turning model improvement goals into concrete task specs.


2. Highly valued experience

  • Experience building or evaluating coding agents, copilot systems, or AI-assisted development tools.
  • Familiarity with coding benchmarks (SWE-Bench, HumanEval, or equivalent).
  • RL or post-training work: RLHF, reward modeling, verifier training, or environment design.
  • Experience designing or maintaining evaluation harnesses for ML systems.
  • Comfort with SQL and structured data workflows


Why Turing

  • Work directly with the world's leading AI labs on the RL environments powering post-training for frontier models.
  • Real impact: your environments and reward systems will directly shape how models learn to reason, act, and improve.
  • Talent-dense team with high autonomy, rapid iteration, and an exceptional learning curve.


Values:

  • We are client first : We put our clients at the center of everything we do, because their success is the ultimate measure of our value.
  • We work at Start-Up Speed: We move fast, stay agile and favor action because momentum is the foundation of perfection
  • We are Al forward: We help our clients build the future of Al and implement it in our own roles and workflow to amplify productivity.


Advantages of joining Turing:

  • Amazing work culture (Super collaborative & supportive work environment; 5 days a week)
  • Awesome colleagues (Surround yourself with top talent from Meta, Google, LinkedIn etc. as well as people with deep startup experience)
  • Competitive compensation
  • Flexible working hours


Don’t meet every single requirement?

Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. Turing is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, protected veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristics. At Turing we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace and celebrate authenticity, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.


For applicants from the European Union, please review Turing's GDPR notice here.

We are looking for a Research Engineer, Coding Agents to help deliver frontier-quality datasets, RL environments, and evaluations that improve state-of-the-art coding models and software engineering agents for leading AI labs and enterprise clients.

This is a hands-on, research-facing technical role. You will work directly with customer researchers and engineers to turn their coding agent improvement goals into concrete data and environment specs — designing tasks that reflect real software engineering work and building the ground-truth systems that verify agent performance.


We're targeting candidates with roughly 4–5 years of experience, ideally combining strong software engineering fundamentals with exposure to ML/AI systems — especially where results depended on data quality, evaluation rigor, or building infrastructure that other engineers rely on.


What You'll Do:

1. Design and deliver datasets and RL environments for coding agents

  • Work with customer researchers to define data requirements for coding agent capabilities: codebase navigation, bug localization, patching, test generation, code reviews, CI-like constraints, refactors, and security fixes.
  • Design task suites that reflect real development work — single-step tasks (fix this bug, write this test) through long-horizon workflows (navigate an unfamiliar repo, diagnose a multi-file issue, produce a reviewed PR).
  • Build ground-truth signals: unit tests, structured checks, automatic validators, and reward functions that verify whether an agent's code actually works.
  • Define environment interfaces — repository structures, dependency contexts, tool schemas — that give agents realistic constraints.


2. Build the quality and validation systems that ensure frontier-grade data

  • Perform deep, detail-oriented audits of produced data — spotting subtle errors, reward hacking opportunities (e.g., agents gaming test suites), leakage, and inconsistent assumptions.
  • Implement automated validation and filtering: deduplication, decontamination, consistency checks, and difficulty/diversity controls.
  • Where appropriate, develop synthetic task generation pipelines: programmatic bug injection, controlled perturbations to existing codebases, and scenario templating across languages and frameworks.


3. Prove impact through evaluations and training runs

  • Design and run evals aligned with coding benchmarks and customer-defined capability targets.
  • Produce analysis connecting data to outcomes: pre/post comparisons on targeted coding tasks, error breakdowns, and ablations identifying which data attributes drive model lift on SWE tasks.
  • When needed, run fine-tuning or RL experiments (or partner with research) to demonstrate measurable coding agent improvement.


4. Collaborate with cross-functional delivery teams

  • Provide clear specs, examples, and edge cases to engineers, QAs, and large-scale data production groups.
  • Run fast feedback loops grounded in code quality metrics and automated signals.
  • Review and improve outputs from large-scale task creation efforts, maintaining a high bar for realism and correctness.


Who We're Looking For:

1. Required Qualifications

  • 4–5 years of professional software engineering or ML engineering experience.
  • Python proficiency required; proficiency in one or more additional major languages (C++, Java, Go, Rust, JS/TS) strongly preferred.
  • Strong intuition for what makes a good coding task — realistic difficulty, clear ground truth, and resistance to shortcut solutions.
  • Demonstrated ability to be extremely detail-oriented: you catch bugs in code that automated tools miss.
  • Experience with testing infrastructure, CI/CD, or code quality systems at a meaningful scale.
  • Ability to communicate clearly with researchers and engineers — turning model improvement goals into concrete task specs.


2. Highly valued experience

  • Experience building or evaluating coding agents, copilot systems, or AI-assisted development tools.
  • Familiarity with coding benchmarks (SWE-Bench, HumanEval, or equivalent).
  • RL or post-training work: RLHF, reward modeling, verifier training, or environment design.
  • Experience designing or maintaining evaluation harnesses for ML systems.
  • Comfort with SQL and structured data workflows


Why Turing

  • Work directly with the world's leading AI labs on the RL environments powering post-training for frontier models.
  • Real impact: your environments and reward systems will directly shape how models learn to reason, act, and improve.
  • Talent-dense team with high autonomy, rapid iteration, and an exceptional learning curve.


Values:

  • We are client first : We put our clients at the center of everything we do, because their success is the ultimate measure of our value.
  • We work at Start-Up Speed: We move fast, stay agile and favor action because momentum is the foundation of perfection
  • We are Al forward: We help our clients build the future of Al and implement it in our own roles and workflow to amplify productivity.


Advantages of joining Turing:

  • Amazing work culture (Super collaborative & supportive work environment; 5 days a week)
  • Awesome colleagues (Surround yourself with top talent from Meta, Google, LinkedIn etc. as well as people with deep startup experience)
  • Competitive compensation
  • Flexible working hours


Don’t meet every single requirement?

Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. Turing is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, protected veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristics. At Turing we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace and celebrate authenticity, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.


For applicants from the European Union, please review Turing's GDPR notice here.

title: Linux/Cloud System Administrator
description:
Your role and responsibilities:


Lead L2/L3 production and project support for Linux environments

Manage installations, patching, migrations, and scripting (Shell & Perl)

Troubleshoot hardware/software issues across Linux(SUSE/RHEL)

Optimize system performance and availability

Coach and mentor team members

Work with ITIL-based tools and monitoring systems


Requirements and Qualifications:


Hands-on experience in Linux systems with Pacemaker cluster

Deep expertise in filesystem, volume, and storage management

Strong knowledge of networking, clustering (PCS), and system hardening

Excellent communication and problem-solving skills

Azure/AWS/GCP(IAAS)

Deploying Virtual machine and Creating, managing internal & external load balancers to allow the public network communication with specific ports.

Configuring VNET & VWAN peering between different networks to allow communication.

Used network security groups, subnets, route tables, local network gateway and application security groups to ensure security for customer networks.



Bonus Points:


Linux certification

Advanced English

Experience with Pacemaker Cluster, DNS, DHCP, LDAP


Please submit resumé in English.

title: Sr. DevOps Engineer
description:
We are looking for a Sr. DevOps Engineer to work for our client. The ideal candidate aligns with the responsibilities and qualifications outlined below.


About the Role

Our client is seeking a DevOps Engineer to support CI/CD pipelines, improve automation, and ensure the reliability of production systems. You’ll work closely with development and infrastructure teams to streamline deployments, enhance performance, and maintain secure, scalable environments.


Responsibilities

  • Manage and improve build/deployment pipelines.
  • Administer Azure DevOps (permissions, branching, policies).
  • Support deployments using tools like Octopus Deploy.
  • Troubleshoot build and deployment issues.
  • Monitor production environments and coordinate upgrades.
  • Implement automation to reduce technical debt and improve CI/CD efficiency.
  • Assist with infrastructure management using Chef, Terraform, or similar tools.
  • Maintain documentation and communicate project status to stakeholders.


Qualifications

  • Fluency in English (written and spoken) is required
  • Microsoft system administration experience.
  • Active Directory, Windows Server, and IIS knowledge.
  • Familiarity with .NET environments and Git.
  • PowerShell scripting skills.
  • Linux administration experience.
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Chef/Terraform).
  • Strong communication and teamwork skills.
  • Experience in agile development environments.


What Our Client Offers

  • 100% remote work in Brazil.
  • Modern DevOps tools and technologies.
  • Collaborative, growth-focused engineering culture.

title: Data Analyst V
description:
Título da posição: Data Analyst V BRL

Tipo de contratação: Temporário via agência

Modelo de trabalho: Home office


Visão Geral da Posição

A equipe de Analytics de BMP (Business Model and Pricing) está em busca de um(a) Analista de Dados experiente para apoiar a gestão de performance do negócio e a tomada de decisões estratégicas por meio de análises avançadas. A equipe atua em parceria próxima com liderança, finanças, operações e stakeholders de negócio para mensurar o desempenho das nossas ofertas aos clientes, gerar insights sobre o comportamento dos clientes e impulsionar ações orientadas por dados em toda a organização.


O(a) Analista de Dados desempenhará um papel crítico na transformação de dados complexos em insights acionáveis, no desenvolvimento de frameworks analíticos e na viabilização do monitoramento de performance por meio de dashboards, relatórios e análises aprofundadas. Esta função exige forte rigor analítico, visão de negócio e capacidade de comunicar insights de forma clara para stakeholders seniores.


O(a) candidato(a) ideal possui histórico comprovado de entrega de análises de alto impacto em ambientes dinâmicos e multifuncionais, além de estar confortável equilibrando análises estruturadas e recorrentes com demandas ad hoc que apoiam prioridades de negócio em constante evolução.


O que você fará

  • Aplicar forte mentalidade analítica e de resolução de problemas para identificar questões de negócio, lacunas de performance e oportunidades de melhoria, traduzindo-as em abordagens analíticas claras.
  • Apoiar iniciativas de BMP fornecendo insights sobre performance do negócio, eficiência operacional, direcionadores financeiros e KPIs estratégicos.
  • Projetar, desenvolver e manter dashboards, relatórios e modelos analíticos para acompanhar a performance em relação às metas e apoiar a tomada de decisão da liderança.
  • Conduzir análises ad hoc e aprofundadas para explicar tendências, variações, riscos e oportunidades, além de avaliar o impacto de iniciativas de negócio.
  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com stakeholders para entender objetivos, definir métricas relevantes e garantir que as entregas analíticas estejam alinhadas às necessidades de decisão.
  • Atuar em parceria com as equipes de engenharia de dados, finanças e outros times de analytics para garantir qualidade, consistência e escalabilidade das soluções de reporte.
  • Sintetizar análises complexas em narrativas claras e objetivas, apresentando resultados que traduzam dados em insights acionáveis para a liderança sênior.
  • Contribuir para a melhoria contínua de frameworks analíticos, ferramentas e melhores práticas dentro da equipe de BMP Analytics.


Qualificações Mínimas

  • Mestrado em Analytics, Ciência de Dados, Economia, Estatística, Engenharia, Administração ou área quantitativa relacionada.
  • Mais de 5 anos de experiência em análise de dados, analytics de negócio ou gestão de performance.
  • Experiência sólida com SQL e pelo menos uma linguagem de programação analítica (Python ou equivalente).
  • Experiência na construção de dashboards e relatórios utilizando ferramentas de BI (preferencialmente Power BI).
  • Forte pensamento analítico, com capacidade comprovada de estruturar problemas ambíguos.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e apresentação, com capacidade de engajar públicos técnicos e não técnicos.
  • Capacidade comprovada de colaboração eficaz em equipes multifuncionais.
  • Inglês fluente.


Qualificações Desejáveis

  • Experiência com análises financeiras ou de gestão de performance de negócios.
  • Familiaridade com técnicas analíticas avançadas (previsão, análise estatística, modelagem de cenários).
  • Experiência com ambientes de dados em nuvem (ex.: AWS).
  • Experiência com pipelines de dados, automação ou ferramentas de orquestração (ex.: Airflow).
  • Experiência com big data ou frameworks de processamento distribuído (ex.: Spark / PySpark).
  • Experiência em organização global matricial.

Esta função exige forte rigor analítico, visão de negócio e capacidade de comunicar insights de forma clara para stakeholders seniores.


O(a) candidato(a) ideal possui histórico comprovado de entrega de análises de alto impacto em ambientes dinâmicos e multifuncionais, além de estar confortável equilibrando análises estruturadas e recorrentes com demandas ad hoc que apoiam prioridades de negócio em constante evolução.


O que você fará

  • Aplicar forte mentalidade analítica e de resolução de problemas para identificar questões de negócio, lacunas de performance e oportunidades de melhoria, traduzindo-as em abordagens analíticas claras.
  • Apoiar iniciativas de BMP fornecendo insights sobre performance do negócio, eficiência operacional, direcionadores financeiros e KPIs estratégicos.
  • Projetar, desenvolver e manter dashboards, relatórios e modelos analíticos para acompanhar a performance em relação às metas e apoiar a tomada de decisão da liderança.
  • Conduzir análises ad hoc e aprofundadas para explicar tendências, variações, riscos e oportunidades, além de avaliar o impacto de iniciativas de negócio.
  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com stakeholders para entender objetivos, definir métricas relevantes e garantir que as entregas analíticas estejam alinhadas às necessidades de decisão.
  • Atuar em parceria com as equipes de engenharia de dados, finanças e outros times de analytics para garantir qualidade, consistência e escalabilidade das soluções de reporte.
  • Sintetizar análises complexas em narrativas claras e objetivas, apresentando resultados que traduzam dados em insights acionáveis para a liderança sênior.
  • Contribuir para a melhoria contínua de frameworks analíticos, ferramentas e melhores práticas dentro da equipe de BMP Analytics.


Qualificações Mínimas

  • Mestrado em Analytics, Ciência de Dados, Economia, Estatística, Engenharia, Administração ou área quantitativa relacionada.
  • Mais de 5 anos de experiência em análise de dados, analytics de negócio ou gestão de performance.
  • Experiência sólida com SQL e pelo menos uma linguagem de programação analítica (Python ou equivalente).
  • Experiência na construção de dashboards e relatórios utilizando ferramentas de BI (preferencialmente Power BI).
  • Forte pensamento analítico, com capacidade comprovada de estruturar problemas ambíguos.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e apresentação, com capacidade de engajar públicos técnicos e não técnicos.
  • Capacidade comprovada de colaboração eficaz em equipes multifuncionais.
  • Inglês fluente.


Qualificações Desejáveis

  • Experiência com análises financeiras ou de gestão de performance de negócios.
  • Familiaridade com técnicas analíticas avançadas (previsão, análise estatística, modelagem de cenários).
  • Experiência com ambientes de dados em nuvem (ex.: AWS).
  • Experiência com pipelines de dados, automação ou ferramentas de orquestração (ex.: Airflow).
  • Experiência com big data ou frameworks de processamento distribuído (ex.: Spark / PySpark).
  • Experiência em organização global matricial.

title: English Teacher
description:
Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!

Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone.


If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!

Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.


What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire?

You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.

If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.

When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!


In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire:


  • Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
  • You be your own boss and set your own schedule
  • Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
  • Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.


Minimum Requirements:


  • Portuguese as a first language.
  • C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
  • University degree in English Teaching or related area.
  • One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
  • Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection.
  • Must pass a criminal background check.
  • Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.


Who we are:

Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

description:

title: Research Engineer, RL Environments
description:
About Turing

Turing builds large-scale datasets and reinforcement learning (RL) environments that power post-training for the world's leading AI labs and enterprises, including OpenAI, Anthropic, Google DeepMind, Microsoft AI, Amazon, Apple, and many more. We create RL environments to evaluate and improve our customers' models on complex, multi-step workflows across high-value domains — designing the tasks, reward signals, and verifiers that drive measurable model improvement through RL training.


The Role

We are looking for a Research Engineer, RL Environments to help design and build frontier-quality RL environments, reward systems, and evaluations that improve state-of-the-art models for leading AI labs and enterprise clients.

This is a hands-on, research-facing technical role. You will work directly with customer researchers and engineers to translate their post-training and RL goals into concrete environment specs — designing tasks with verifiable outcomes, building reward and verifier systems, and ensuring environments are robust against reward hacking and distribution collapse.


We're targeting candidates with roughly 4–5 years of experience building deep learning or RL systems — especially where strong results depended on environment design, reward engineering, training infrastructure, or rigorous evaluation.


What You'll Do:

1. Design and build RL environments and verifier systems

  • Work with customer researchers to translate RL training goals into environment specs: target capabilities, task distributions, difficulty curves, and success criteria.
  • Design task suites with verifiable outcomes — single-step and long-horizon workflows with clear ground-truth signals.
  • Build reward functions, verifiers, automatic validators, and evaluation harnesses that provide reliable training signal and resist gaming.
  • Define environment interfaces: APIs, tool schemas, state abstractions, database schemas, and simulator-like dynamics that give agents realistic constraints.


2. Build quality systems that keep environments robust at scale

  • Audit environments and trajectories for subtle failure modes: reward hacking, leakage, ambiguity, distribution shifts, and degenerate task distributions.
  • Implement automated validation: deduplication, decontamination, consistency checks, difficulty controls, and diversity monitoring.
  • Develop synthetic task generation and augmentation pipelines: programmatic generators, controlled perturbations, hard negatives, and scenario templating with diversity constraints.


3. Prove impact through evaluations and training runs

  • Design and run evals reflecting customer-intended model capabilities.
  • Produce analysis connecting environment design choices to training outcomes: pre/post comparisons, error breakdowns, and ablations identifying which environment and reward attributes drive model lift.
  • When needed, run RL or fine-tuning experiments (or partner with research) to validate that your environments produce measurable improvement.


4. Collaborate with cross-functional delivery teams

  • Provide clear specs, examples, and edge cases to engineers, domain SMEs, and data production groups.
  • Run fast feedback loops based on trajectory analysis and quantitative signals.
  • Review and improve outputs from large-scale task and environment creation efforts.


Who We're Looking For:

1. Required Qualifications

  • 4–5 years of experience building or improving deep learning or RL systems where environment design, data quality, or reward engineering mattered materially.
  • Hands-on experience with reinforcement learning — any of: environment/gym development, reward design, PPO/GRPO/DPO, trajectory collection, or RL training infrastructure.
  • Strong intuition for what makes a good training task: verifiability, appropriate difficulty, resistance to shortcuts, and realistic constraints.
  • Demonstrated ability to be extremely detail-oriented in diagnosing subtle quality issues and failure modes in data or environments.
  • Python proficiency required; comfort with SQL and structured data workflows strongly preferred.
  • Ability to communicate clearly with researchers and engineers — turning RL training objectives into concrete environment specs.


2. Highly valued experience

  • Post-training experience: RLHF/RLAIF, verifier training, reward modeling, or constitutional AI methods.
  • Experience building custom gym environments, simulators, or distributed RL training systems.
  • Agentic evaluation: tool use, multi-step workflows, long-horizon tasks, trajectory analysis.
  • Systems thinking: ability to simulate an application's API and data schema and design tasks reflecting real-world constraints.
  • Experience with LLM fine-tuning at scale.


Why Turing

  • Work directly with the world's leading AI labs on the RL environments powering post-training for frontier models.
  • Real impact: your environments and reward systems will directly shape how models learn to reason, act, and improve.
  • Talent-dense team with high autonomy, rapid iteration, and an exceptional learning curve.


Values:

  • We are client first : We put our clients at the center of everything we do, because their success is the ultimate measure of our value.
  • We work at Start-Up Speed: We move fast, stay agile and favor action because momentum is the foundation of perfection
  • We are Al forward: We help our clients build the future of Al and implement it in our own roles and workflow to amplify productivity.


Advantages of joining Turing:

  • Amazing work culture (Super collaborative & supportive work environment; 5 days a week)
  • Awesome colleagues (Surround yourself with top talent from Meta, Google, LinkedIn etc. as well as people with deep startup experience)
  • Competitive compensation
  • Flexible working hours


Don’t meet every single requirement?

Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. Turing is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, protected veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristics. At Turing we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace and celebrate authenticity, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.


For applicants from the European Union, please review Turing's GDPR notice here.

title: Senior Data Engineer with AWS (Relocation to Portugal)
description:
Your connection with Aubay starts in the following lines:

Aubay Portugal is a multinational French company, in Portugal since 2007. We have offices in Lisbon and Oporto and we are a specialized consultant in Management, Implementation, Development and Maintenance of Information Systems. We have more than 150 active partners and we operate in sectors such as banking, insurance, telecommunications, services, energy and transports.


What are we looking for?

  • Minimum of 5 years of experience as a Data Engineer;
  • Experience working with public cloud platforms, especially AWS;
  • Ability to code in at least one programming language (Python, Java, JavaScript, Scala) is a must;
  • Experience using a querying language such as SQL;
  • Willingness to relocate to Portugal;
  • B2 English is mandatory.


What do we have to offer you?

  • Health Insurance;
  • Feedback&Coffee – the system that includes Aubay’s Performance Management Cycle, with regular moments of feedback and the Career Progression Model;
  • Working model: hybrid/remote/on-site;
  • A Training Academy designed to think of you and your needs. You can count on technical and behavioural training sessions (e-Learning and classroom), Meet&Techs, Webinars and Mentoring;
  • Events and Teambuildings.


What makes us different?

  • Our organizational culture is based on values such as transparency, team spirit, regular feedback and continuous learning;
  • Reference prizes and birthday present;
  • We don’t have a dress code;
  • We know your name and all address each other informally;
  • You will grow in good company. Isn’t this one of the ways in which to develop professionally?


If we got your attention, we now hope to spark your enthusiasm. Ready for the first phase? We are waiting for you:


Personal Data collected by AUBAY PORTUGAL as Data Controller, regarding the identification, contact and professional capabilities of the candidates, in the present procedure, will be processed for the application analysis, having in consideration that the processing is conducted in order to to take the steps, at the request of the data subject, prior to entering into a contract;

Personal data sent through the present application will be kept by Aubay during the application procedure and will remain stored whilst updated (for two years period). The collected data might be transferred or include other processing actitivites, as long as the data subject is informed, in the occurrence of a standard application and selection procedure, for the compliance of legal obligations for the time required by law. For any queries or request regarding personal data protection rights, the Data Subject may contact AUBAY PORTUGAL’s headquarters in Avenida Duque D`Ávila, nº46 em Lisboa or use the DPO’s e-mail - . The Data Subject also has the right to file a complaint with the National Data Protection Authority – (please do not include data regarding racial or ethnical origins, political opinions, religion, philosophy, biometrical data, health data, sexual life and orientation, or relating to o criminal convictions and offences.)

title: Consultor de Governança
description:
Buscamos um profissional para liderar a estruturação e a manutenção do nosso ecossistema de dados. O foco principal será a implementação e gestão do Unity Catalog , estabelecendo políticas de governança que garantam a segurança, conformidade e qualidade dos dados utilizados em modelos de Analytics e Inteligência Artificial.


Principais Responsabilidades

  • Gestão de Unity Catalog: Configurar e administrar o Unity Catalog (Databricks) para garantir o controle de acesso centralizado (lineage, permissões e auditoria).
  • Políticas de Governança: Desenvolver e implementar políticas de governança de dados e IA, garantindo que o ciclo de vida dos dados esteja em conformidade com normas (como LGPD) e boas práticas de mercado.
  • Documentação Técnica: Atuar ativamente na criação de catálogos de dados, dicionários, diagramas de linhagem e manuais de processos. A documentação será um pilar central da entrega.
  • Governança de IA: Estabelecer diretrizes para o uso ético e seguro de modelos de IA, monitorando a qualidade dos dados de entrada (inputs) e a rastreabilidade dos modelos.
  • Segurança e Acessos: Definir e gerenciar perfis de acesso, garantindo que a democratização dos dados ocorra de forma segura.
  • Colaboração: Atuar como ponte entre as equipes de Engenharia de Dados, Cientistas de Dados e Stakeholders de negócio para garantir a integridade da informação.


Requisitos Técnicos (Hard Skills)

  • Experiência sólida com Databricks e configuração de Unity Catalog .
  • Conhecimento profundo em SQL e linguagens utilizadas em ambiente de dados (Python ou Scala).
  • Vivência com frameworks de Governança de Dados (DAMA-DMBOK, COBIT ou similares).
  • Experiência com ferramentas de Catálogo de Dados e Linhagem (Data Lineage).
  • Entendimento de fluxos de MLOps e governança aplicada a modelos de IA.
  • Habilidade excepcional em escrita técnica e documentação.


Diferenciais

  • Certificações Databricks (Certified Data Engineer ou similar).
  • Conhecimento em infraestrutura de nuvem (AWS, Azure ou GCP).
  • Experiência prévia em projetos de migração para ambientes de governança centralizada.


Perfil Desejado (Soft Skills)

  • Perfil Analítico: Capacidade de organizar grandes volumes de informação de forma lógica.
  • Atenção aos Detalhes: Rigor com a padronização e qualidade da documentação.
  • Comunicação Assertiva: Capacidade de explicar políticas complexas de forma simples para diferentes áreas.
