description:
Descrição:

Título da Posição: Engenheiro(a) de Software Full Stack Sênior

Tipo de contratação: Temporário via agência

Modelo de trabalho: Home office

Número de vagas: 2


Formação mínima exigida: Bacharelado em Ciência da Computação ou área relacionada, ou experiência equivalente.


Top 3 requisitos obrigatórios no currículo:

  • Forte experiência em desenvolvimento backend com atuação prática em serviços AWS.
  • Experiência comprovada no design e construção de sistemas distribuídos e escaláveis.
  • Experiência Full Stack com desenvolvimento moderno de front-end (NodeJS e React).


Visão geral do processo seletivo:

  • Entrevista de Design de Sistemas com o time de engenharia, com foco em arquitetura e design de sistemas.
  • Entrevista de Resolução de Problemas com o gerente contratante e um engenheiro, para avaliar capacidade de resolução de problemas, comunicação e alinhamento com a equipe.


Descrição da Vaga

Visão Geral da Posição

A equipe Autodesk Info360 está em busca de um(a) Engenheiro(a) de Software Sênior experiente para integrar o time. Nesta função, você ajudará a projetar, construir e escalar soluções cloud-native que impulsionam fluxos de trabalho modernos de gestão de recursos hídricos.

Esta é uma posição de alto impacto, com foco em backend e arquitetura em nuvem, mantendo também forte responsabilidade sobre experiências voltadas ao usuário.


Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver soluções inovadoras para gestão de recursos hídricos em fluxos de trabalho orientados a produto.
  • Projetar e construir serviços backend escaláveis e cloud-native na AWS, utilizando arquitetura híbrida entre containers e serverless.
  • Desenvolver código de qualidade para produção, testável, legível e eficiente.
  • Arquitetar e implementar processos complexos de carga e transformação de dados em alto volume e alta frequência, utilizando métodos e ferramentas ETL de ponta.
  • Fornecer orientação técnica e suporte aos colegas por meio de revisões de design, code reviews e colaboração contínua.
  • Projetar e desenvolver funcionalidades voltadas ao usuário utilizando React e ferramentas modernas de desenvolvimento web.
  • Atuar como líder técnico(a) em iniciativas específicas de engenharia, contribuindo para decisões arquiteturais e de implementação.


Qualificações:

  • 10+ anos de experiência profissional em desenvolvimento de software, incluindo experiência relevante em arquitetura de sistemas.
  • Experiência comprovada no design e construção de sistemas distribuídos e escaláveis.
  • Fortes habilidades de comunicação, tanto escrita quanto verbal, para articular ideias complexas a diferentes stakeholders.
  • Excelente capacidade analítica, de resolução de problemas e pensamento crítico.
  • Profunda expertise em desenvolvimento cloud-native, com experiência prática em serviços AWS como Lambda, API Gateway e DynamoDB.
  • Experiência com AWS IoT é um diferencial.
  • Experiência com Infraestrutura como Código (IaC) — Terraform ou CloudFormation — é um diferencial.
  • 3+ anos de experiência com React e seu ecossistema.
  • Conhecimento em conceitos de Machine Learning é um diferencial.

title: Engenheiro de Software Sênior | Flutter | PJ
description:
Grupo Smart Fit, a força que ativa o seu potencial.

O Grupo Smart Fit é a maior plataforma de fitness e bem-estar da América Latina e um dos grupos que mais crescem no mundo. Com atuação em mais de 16 países, mais de 2.000 unidades, mais de 23 mil colaboradores e um ecossistema completo de marcas, impactamos milhões de pessoas todos os dias por meio de experiências que promovem saúde, movimento e qualidade de vida.

Aqui, fazer parte do time é crescer junto. Buscamos pessoas que queiram treinar para evoluir sempre, assumir protagonismo na carreira e construir uma trajetória sólida dentro de um grupo forte, em constante expansão e movimento.

Trabalhar no Grupo Smart Fit é levar na carreira a força de um grande grupo global, com visão de longo prazo, estrutura robusta e oportunidades reais de crescimento, mobilidade entre marcas e novos desafios ao longo da jornada.

Tudo isso em uma cultura de alta performance, forte, colaborativa e conectada ao nosso propósito. Nosso ecossistema reúne marcas que atuam em diferentes frentes do fitness e bem-estar: academias como Smart Fit, Bio Ritmo e Nation CT; studios como Race Bootcamp, Vidya Studio, Jab House, Tonus Gym, Aera Pilates, Velocity e Kore; e produtos digitais, TotalPass e Queima Diária.


Principais responsabilidades:


1. Arquitetura e Engenharia de Software

Arquitetura Escalável

  • Definir e manter a arquitetura do aplicativo (ex.: Clean Architecture, modularização)
  • Garantir base de código preparada para alta complexidade e múltiplos desenvolvedores


Evolução e Qualidade

  • Desenvolver funcionalidades críticas com alta testabilidade e baixo acoplamento
  • Servir como referência técnica de implementação para o time


Estratégia de Releases Semanais

  • Orquestrar tecnicamente o ciclo de releases
  • Garantir fluxo de CI/CD e integração contínua de código sem regressões


2. Liderança Técnica e Colaboração Estratégica

Mentoria e Code Review

  • Liderar revisões de código com foco educativo
  • Elevar o nível técnico do time
  • Garantir cumprimento dos padrões arquiteturais estabelecidos


Parceria com Produto e Liderança

  • Atuar como consultor técnico para o Líder Técnico e Gerente de Produto
  • Antecipar complexidades técnicas
  • Estimar esforços com precisão
  • Sugerir alternativas técnicas para acelerar o time-to-market


Integração Sistêmica (Backend)

  • Liderar, junto ao time de Backend, a definição de contratos de API e arquitetura de dados
  • Garantir performance, segurança e economia de recursos no mobile


3. Governança e Sustentação

Gestão de Incidentes (L3)

  • Atuar na resolução de bugs críticos e problemas complexos em produção

Desenvolvimento e estudo das diversas etapas para a elaboração de Propostas Técnicas e Comerciais para clientes de Infraestrutura, assim como apoio às obras em andamento:

Conhecimento em Softwares de Orçamentos (Compor 90, RM, etc) e Planejamento de Obras (Project, Primavera e afins);

Superior completo em Engenharia Civil ou Produção.

Pós-graduação na área de Engenharia de Custos (desejável);

title: StarRocks Database Engineer (DBE) - Remote
description:
Database Engineer (DBE) – Enterprise Open-Source Support

Location : Remote (preferred South / Central America or US TIme Zones)

Department : Engineering - Open Source Database support

Reports to: CTO / VP Engineering


About Deep.BI

We provide enterprise support and consulting for open‑source analytics and data infrastructure platforms such as Apache Druid, Apache Flink, StarRocks and other emerging technologies.Our customers run mission‑critical, high‑volume systems and rely on us to keep them fast, stable, and available. We’re a small, world-class expert, remote‑first team working across multiple time zones (US, Brazil, Europe, India, Philippines), supporting 100+ customer environments with SLAs ranging from advisory support to 24/7 incident coverage.


Role Overview

As a Database Engineer (DBE), you will be the core L3/L4 technical expert responsible for solving the most complex database problems our customers face in production with an emphasis on supporting StarRocks clusters. You’ll dive deep into query optimization, ingestion pipelines, schema design, and HA/DR configuration — ensuring that large-scale analytical systems remain reliable, scalable, and performant.


While your primary focus is database internals and advanced troubleshooting, we value engineers with broader skills — knowledge of DevOps, Infrastructure, security or SRE Practices is highly appreciated and will make you even more impactful. 


Key Responsibilities

  • Advanced troubleshooting (L3/L4): Diagnose and resolve complex issues in StarRocks and other OLAP database clusters (performance Bottlenecks, ingestion failures, query regressions)
  • Performance optimization: Tune queries, schemas, ingestion flows, and configs to maximize efficiency under high load.
  • Architecture & design support: Work with Solution Architects to shape data models, indexing strategies, and HA/DR approaches.
  • Incident resolution under 24/7 SLA: Comfortable debugging under SLA pressure and participating in on-call rotations. Act as the escalation point for production incidents, ensuring rapid root cause analysis and fixes.
  • CVE patching: Apply, validate, and test security patches for database systems in customer environments.
  • Knowledge sharing: Document best practices, contribute to playbooks, and mentor junior engineers when needed.
  • Optional / nice-to-have:
  • Support deployments with DevOps engineers (Kubernetes, cloud, automation)
  • Assist in secure configuration and compliance requirements
  • Collaborate with developers (DD role) on upstream OSS bug fixes or feature contributions.


Requirements

  • 2+ years hands-on experience operating and troubleshooting StarRocks clusters in larger scale production (not just querying or dashboard usage; no PoCs) 
  • Proven experience with query optimization,indexing, schema design, and ingestion pipelines .
  • Solid knowledge of distributed systems concepts (consistency, replication, failover, scaling)
  • Hands-on experience with high availability and disaster recovery setups
  • Comfort with Linux systems, networking basics and SQL .
  • Ability to analyze logs, metrics, and configs under pressure (incident scenarios)
  • Strong English language communication skills — able to explain technical decisions clearly to engineers and delivery managers both verbally and in writing
  • Bonus: Experience with Apache Druid, ClickHouse, TiDB, Apache Cassandra, or similar databases
  • Bonus : Experience with Kubernetes, cloud infra (AWS/GCP/Azure), or security best practices (RBAC, encryption, IAM).
  • Bonus : Contributions to open-source database projects.


What we offer

  • Work with cutting-edge open-source technologies at enterprise scale .
  • Opportunity to collaborate with top engineers across databases, communities.
  • Competitive salary 
  • Support for conference travel and OSS contributions
  • Flexible contract structure (direct employment or via a global payroll partner or contractor/B2B), depending on your location and preference.


Location & working style

  • Remote‑first - we collaborate online across multiple time zones.
  • Role requires regular overlap with European and North American business hours.

title: Líder técnico
description:
Requisitos Obrigatórios


  • Experiência como Tech Lead, liderando um time de desenvolvimento.
  • Domínio em .NET e C# , especialmente em .NET 6 ou Core 5+ para desenvolvimento de APIs. Prática com ASP.NET Core , Web APIs , Minimal API Controllers , autenticação e validação em middleware.
  • Experiência com AWS , especialmente API Gateway , AWS Lambda , CloudWatch , EventBridge , SQS e SNS , e boas práticas de segurança e logs.
  • Capacidade de estruturar soluções assincronas e event-driven.
  • Conhecimento em boas práticas de DDD light e separação de camadas.
  • Familiaridade com CI/CD usando ferramentas como GitHub Actions , GitLab , Azure DevOps ou AWS CodePipeline .
  • Conhecimento em infraestrutura como código com AWS SAM ou Terraform .
  • Experiência anterior com projetos financeiros, especialmente envolvendo cessão de crédito.


Requisitos Desejáveis


  • Noções de containers como Docker . Experiência com sistemas financeiros, especialmente em projetos de cessão de crédito.
  • Conhecimento em serviços de cache como Redis ou Memcached .
  • Capacidade de testar soluções localmente utilizando ferramentas como dotnet lambda test tool , localstack , Postman , e Insomnia .


Summary of Requirements: .NET , C# , ASP.NET Core , AWS , API Gateway , AWS Lambda , CloudWatch , EventBridge , SQS , SNS , DDD light , CI/CD , AWS SAM , Terraform .

  • Domínio em .NET e C# , especialmente em .NET 6 ou Core 5+ para desenvolvimento de APIs. Prática com ASP.NET Core , Web APIs , Minimal API Controllers , autenticação e validação em middleware.
  • Experiência com AWS , especialmente API Gateway , AWS Lambda , CloudWatch , EventBridge , SQS e SNS , e boas práticas de segurança e logs.
  • Capacidade de estruturar soluções assincronas e event-driven.
  • Conhecimento em boas práticas de DDD light e separação de camadas.
  • Familiaridade com CI/CD usando ferramentas como GitHub Actions , GitLab , Azure DevOps ou AWS CodePipeline .
  • Conhecimento em infraestrutura como código com AWS SAM ou Terraform .
  • Experiência anterior com projetos financeiros, especialmente envolvendo cessão de crédito.


Requisitos Desejáveis


  • Noções de containers como Docker . Experiência com sistemas financeiros, especialmente em projetos de cessão de crédito.
  • Conhecimento em serviços de cache como Redis ou Memcached .
  • Capacidade de testar soluções localmente utilizando ferramentas como dotnet lambda test tool , localstack , Postman , e Insomnia .

title: Systems Engineer
description:
We are looking for a Systems Engineer to work for our client. The ideal candidate aligns with the responsibilities and qualifications outlined below.


If you’re a systems expert who thrives in cloud‑driven, enterprise environments and you want a fully remote role with real technical ownership, this opportunity will give you the autonomy, complexity, and impact you’re looking for.


About the Role

Our client is seeking a skilled Systems Engineer with strong experience in virtualization, directory services, cloud environments, and enterprise server administration. In this role, you’ll support and optimize core infrastructure, improve system reliability, modernize environments, and play a critical part in supporting global teams.


This is the perfect position for someone who enjoys solving complex technical challenges and working with a modern Microsoft‑centered stack.


What You’ll Do

  • Manage and optimize VMware environments, including configuration, monitoring, and troubleshooting
  • Administer Active Directory, Azure Active Directory, identity management, and group policy
  • Support and maintain Windows Server environments across production and staging platforms
  • Implement and manage Azure cloud services, virtual machines, and hybrid integrations
  • Monitor system performance and ensure high availability of critical infrastructure
  • Lead incident resolution, root cause analysis, and remediation efforts
  • Support infrastructure automation, documentation, and best‑practice improvements
  • Collaborate with global IT teams to implement system upgrades, patches, and enhancements
  • Maintain security standards and ensure compliance across systems and environments


What You Bring

  • Fluency in English (written and spoken) is required
  • 5+ years of Systems Engineering experience
  • Strong hands‑on experience with VMware virtualization
  • Advanced knowledge of Active Directory administration
  • Experience managing and maintaining Windows Server environments
  • Working knowledge of Azure infrastructure and cloud services
  • Understanding of networking fundamentals (DNS, DHCP, firewalls, routing preferred)
  • Experience troubleshooting complex enterprise infrastructure issues
  • Strong communication skills and ability to work cross‑functionally in a remote environment
  • Ability to manage priorities and self‑direct in a distributed team structure


What Our Client Offers

  • Fully remote role based in Brazil with global team collaboration
  • Opportunity to work with modern virtualization and cloud infrastructure
  • High‑impact systems ownership with strong visibility across IT leadership
  • Professional development, cloud learning resources, and certification support
  • Competitive compensation, benefits, and long‑term growth opportunities
  • A collaborative, engineering‑minded culture that values innovation and continuous improvement

title: Sr. Principal Backend Engineer
description:
*Native/Bilingual English is required for this role (read/written/spoken)


Please upload your CV Resume in English.


Monthly salary: $7,000 - $8,500 USD


Our partner revolutionizes clinical decision support by enhancing diagnostic accuracy and personalizing care. They modernize the diagnostic process by automating optimal lab test selection and interpretation, leveraging expert medical insights, real-world data, and artificial intelligence.


Their platform orchestrates and automates the entire diagnostic journey, reducing clinical complexity while integrating comprehensive medical histories and collective platform knowledge. They combine AI-driven clinical decision automation with instant provider payments, removing administrative and financial barriers for healthcare providers. This approach streamlines workflows, improves diagnostic accuracy, supports provider profitability, and enables clinicians to focus on delivering precise, individualized patient care.



Job Details:

We are seeking a Principal Backend Engineer to lead the design and development of our core platform services and integrations. The ideal candidate will bring deep technical expertise, systems-level thinking, and experience leading complex backend initiatives. This role is hands-on and strategic, guiding architectural decisions while mentoring engineers across the backend team.


As a principal engineer, you will influence platform design, scalability, reliability, and security at a company-wide level, working closely with product, data, and operations teams to deliver mission-critical functionality.



Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead the design and implementation of scalable, secure, and reliable backend platform services and APIs.
  • Define architectural standards and best practices for backend services and integrations across the company.
  • Collaborate with product managers and stakeholders to translate complex requirements into elegant technical solutions.
  • Mentor and guide backend engineers, sharing technical expertise and promoting engineering excellence.
  • Build and maintain robust integrations with third-party systems, ensuring seamless data exchange and operational reliability.
  • Identify and drive performance optimization, scalability improvements, and platform enhancements.
  • Implement advanced monitoring, alerting, and observability solutions to maintain high system availability.
  • Influence technical strategy and participate in cross-functional architectural decisions.
  • Experience with HL7/FHIR and healthcare interoperability standards is a strong plus.


Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • 8+ years of backend development experience, with expertise in designing platform services and complex integrations.
  • Deep proficiency in Node.js, JavaScript, TypeScript, MongoDB, SQL/noSQL, and cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure).
  • Strong systems thinking and experience leading technical architecture for complex domains.
  • Proven ability to mentor and guide engineering teams, setting high technical standards.
  • Experience working in complex domains, ideally U.S. Healthcare.
  • English fluency required.
  • Previous experience working at Nubank or a similar fintech is highly desirable.


Strengths We Value:

  • Strategic, systems-level thinking and ownership of end-to-end backend architecture.
  • Ability to operate in ambiguous, fast-moving environments while maintaining high reliability and correctness.
  • Mentorship and knowledge-sharing skills that elevate the engineering team.
  • Pragmatic, performance-oriented approach to platform scalability, observability, and operational resilience.


*Please note our partner is only looking for full-time dedicated team members who are eager to fully integrate within their team.

Somos globais. Somos GPTW. E somos movidos por pessoas.

♿


Na Foursys, acreditamos que diversidade é potência. Valorizamos diferentes histórias, ideias e perspectivas — aqui, sua cor, religião, gênero, raça, nacionalidade, idade, origem, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou orientação sexual não são barreiras. São parte do que nos fortalece.

Quer fazer parte do time e se tornar um(a) #FourTalent ? Então olha essa oportunidade

Atuar no time de CRM Systems (Salesforce) desenvolvendo e evoluindo soluções com foco em Service Cloud, garantindo qualidade técnica, aderência às boas práticas de desenvolvimento e integração com demais sistemas corporativos.

  • Implementação e evolução de Apex
  • Implementação e utilização de Platform Events
  • Desenvolvimento e manutenção de Flows

  • Integração e deploy utilizando Jenkins
  • Interação com áreas de negócio para entendimento das demandas

title: Front-End & UI/UX Designer
description:
Hey, Dingus!


Yep—you read that right. Dingus & Zazzy is expanding, and we’re on the hunt for a versatile, design-driven Webflow + WordPress expert who can take a website from concept to completion.


About Us


Dingus & Zazzy is a global digital marketing agency helping brands grow across every corner of the digital landscape. We offer an “unlimited get-shit-done” subscription for our clients—from websites to social to SEO and everything in between.


Our team is full of creatives, strategists, tech geeks, and builders who love making brands look, feel, and perform better online. If that sounds like your vibe, keep reading.


What You’ll Do


  • Design visually engaging websites using UI/UX best practices, accessibility standards, and performance guidelines in Figma.
  • Develop approved designs into fully-built, functional websites using Webflow and WordPress.
  • Create wireframes, prototypes, and full website designs that align with user needs and client goals.
  • Use AI tools (Gemini, Claude) for web design, development, and prototyping.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to clarify requirements and ensure flawless execution.
  • Customize, refine, and optimize websites based on client feedback.
  • Stay up-to-date with digital design trends, tools, and new Figma/Webflow/WordPress capabilities.
  • Troubleshoot design-related issues and ensure smooth handoff and deployment.


What You Bring


  • 3+ years of professional experience designing using Figma AND developing websites using Webflow and WordPress.
  • A strong portfolio showcasing web design, UX/UI work, prototypes, and completed builds.
  • Proficiency in wireframing tools and design platforms (Figma, XD, Sketch, etc.).
  • Solid understanding of HTML, CSS, and responsive design principles.
  • Experience with site performance optimization and SEO-friendly design practices.
  • Ability to work effectively within a fully remote team.
  • Strong communication skills—you can articulate design decisions clearly.
  • Close attention to detail and a passion for creating elevated digital experiences.


Bonus Points


  • Experience with animations or micro-interactions in Webflow.
  • Familiarity with brand identity or graphic design.
  • Experience working in fast-paced agency settings.

  • Hours: 9 A.M. – 5 P.M. MST, Monday to Friday
  • Requires a working level of written and spoken English

title: Risk Control Analyst
description:
Job Responsibilities

  • Investigate and analyze various risk behaviors, including fraud, phishing, and account theft , and take appropriate actions to reduce user losses and improve user satisfaction.
  • Continuously monitor user behavior and prepare investigation reports for identified risk cases.
  • Identify potential risk patterns, maintain a case database , and summarize behavioral characteristics.
  • Detect data anomalies through risk management and real-time monitoring , and coordinate with relevant teams to prevent potential losses.
  • Monitor and manage daily risk control processes to ensure the security and compliance of account activities.
  • Conduct regular reconciliation operations to ensure account balances match actual assets, identifying and resolving discrepancies.
  • Analyze existing risk management processes and policies , and provide recommendations for improvement.
  • Facilitate effective communication with internal departments and external partners to ensure timely information flow.
  • Independently handle unexpected issues and propose effective solutions.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree or above .
  • 1–3 years of experience in risk investigation and analysis.
  • Experience in anti-fraud, AML, settlement, or reconciliation in payment institutions, exchanges, banks, or related industries is preferred.
  • Data analysis experience is a plus.
  • Strong communication and written skills , with the ability to collaborate across teams.
  • Strong logical thinking and analytical ability , capable of breaking down complex data.
  • Fluency in Chinese is required.

title: AutoDesk Software Developer - INTL
description:
Location: INTL - Brazil, Mexico, Chile, Costa Rica

Term: Contract. 12-months.

Type: Remote

Rate: Hourly

Job Description

Insight Global is looking for an Intermediate Software Developer to join a large construction company in a remote 12-month contract with possibility of extension based in Edmonton Alberta but working out of Latin America. This role is focused on designing, building, maintaining, and evolving a portfolio of 50+ custom software tools that support Virtual Design & Construction (VDC) and Building Information Modeling (BIM) workflows across the organization.

The Intermediate Software Developer will work hands-on with existing codebases to enhance, refactor, modernize, or retire tools based on usage, stability, and business value. This individual will collaborate closely with internal developers, VDC and BIM specialists, ICT partners, and external vendors to deliver high quality, maintainable solutions that remain aligned with the latest Autodesk platforms and APIs, providing real-world impact across multiple districts.

Required Skills & Experience

• Strong recent experience developing software for Autodesk products, including Revit and Navisworks

• Hands-on development experience with .NET and C#, including deep experience using the Revit API and Navisworks API

• Solid understanding of software architecture, versioning, and long-term maintainability

• Experience working with modern development and deployment tools, such as Azure DevOps and cloud-based CI/CD pipelines

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field

Nice to Have Skills & Experience

•Experience working with Power BI or other data-driven tooling

•Familiarity with Autodesk Forge / APS and external API integrations

•Background developing or supporting custom software within construction, engineering, or AEC environments

title: Desenvolvedor(a) FrontEnd Pleno | Plataforma
description:
A Plataforma desenvolve produtos que sustentam experiências digitais essenciais dentro do ecossistema Sankhya, com foco em reutilização, escala e qualidade.

A missão desta posição é construir interfaces frontend modernas e reutilizáveis , contribuindo para a evolução técnica do time e para uma experiência consistente e escalável.


Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver interfaces frontend com foco em reutilização
  • Atuar com arquitetura de Micro Front-End
  • Criar e customizar componentes em Design System
  • Trabalhar com Web Components
  • Integrar interfaces com serviços backend
  • Colaborar com times multidisciplinares
  • Propor melhorias técnicas e de usabilidade
  • Utilizar ferramentas de Inteligência Artificial no dia a dia de engenharia para apoio em diagnóstico de problemas, revisão de código, documentação técnica e aceleração de entregas, garantindo uso responsável e seguro das informações.


Requisitos

  • Experiência com React
  • Conhecimento em arquitetura de Micro Front-End
  • Vivência com Web Components, preferencialmente Stencil
  • Experiência com Design System e componentes reutilizáveis
  • Boa comunicação e colaboração
  • Versatilidade técnica e proatividade


Procuramos profissionais que gostem de construir soluções escaláveis, trabalhar de forma colaborativa e evoluir tecnicamente em um ambiente com autonomia e impacto real. Se você se identifica com esse contexto, queremos te conhecer.


LOCALIDADE

Uberlândia/MG – Presencial

São Paulo/SP – Híbrido (2x/semana no escritório)

Outras localidades – Remoto


BENEFÍCIOS

Remuneração Variável + Participação nos Resultados (PPR)

title: Analista de Dados (Engenharia & Integração SAP)
description:
Analista de Dados (Engenharia & Integração SAP)


100% Remoto

PJ


Estamos em busca de um Analista de Dados para atuar diretamente na migração e descomissionamento de sistemas SAP (ECC → S/4HANA) , apoiando o time de Engenharia e Arquitetura de Dados.


O profissional será responsável por executar atividades práticas de integração, mapeamento e migração de dados, garantindo qualidade e rastreabilidade em todo o processo.


Principais responsabilidades:

  • Apoiar o processo de migração de dados entre os ambientes SAP ECC e S/4HANA.
  • Realizar o mapeamento de origens, transformações e regras de negócio utilizando SAP Data Services (DS) .
  • Conduzir análises de dados e validações de qualidade para garantir consistência e completude.
  • Executar atividades de integração com SAP SLT (fontes S/4) e DS (fontes ECC) .
  • Colaborar com o time técnico na construção de pipelines e processos de carga para o Data Lake (Databricks, Synapse, Azure SQL) .
  • Documentar processos, tabelas e fluxos de dados, assegurando rastreabilidade e governança.
  • Apoiar a equipe no descomissionamento dos ambientes legados.


Atividades práticas do dia a dia:

  • Desenvolver e ajustar jobs no SAP Data Services .
  • Mapear tabelas de origem SAP e relacionar com os destinos no ambiente cloud.
  • Criar documentação e planilhas de mapeamento e data lineage.
  • Fazer testes de extração, transformação e carga, acompanhando logs e performance.
  • Participar de checkpoints técnicos com equipe de Engenharia e Coordenação.
  • Apoiar análises de erros, inconsistências e ajustes nas integrações.


Experiências desejáveis:

  • Experiência anterior com SAP Data Services (DS) e integrações SAP ECC / S/4HANA .
  • Conhecimento em integrações SLT e fluxos de replicação entre sistemas SAP.
  • Vivência em projetos de migração ou descomissionamento de sistemas SAP .
  • Desejável conhecimento em Databricks, Synapse ou Azure SQL .
  • Perfil hands on, analítico e proativo , com boa organização e atenção a detalhes.
  • Disponibilidade para início imediato (ASAP) .

title: Customer Success Manager
description:
About Us

Marketing Ninjas is a cutting-edge marketing agency specializing in helping restoration companies gain more referral partners and secure exclusive leads. As a faith-driven and ninja-themed company, we operate with the highest standards, integrity, and a commitment to excellence. Our mission is to empower our clients with the tools and strategies they need to grow their businesses successfully.


Job Overview

We’re looking for a Client Success Manager (CSM) who is passionate about building relationships, ensuring client satisfaction, and driving results. The CSM will serve as the primary point of contact for our clients, ensuring they see maximum value from our services and continue to grow with us. This role requires exceptional communication skills, a strong command of English with minimal accent , and a proactive approach to client engagement.


Key Responsibilities

  • Client Onboarding & Relationship Management: Guide new clients through the onboarding process, ensuring a smooth and positive experience.
  • Ongoing Support & Strategy: Regularly check in with clients to review performance, provide strategic insights, and optimize their marketing campaigns.
  • Retention & Growth: Identify opportunities for upselling or cross-selling additional services to help clients scale their businesses.
  • Issue Resolution: Address client concerns promptly and professionally, working with internal teams to resolve any challenges.
  • Training & Education: Educate clients on best practices for using our Marketing Ninjas Lead Engine , powered by GoHighLevel .
  • Performance Monitoring: Track client success metrics and proactively reach out to offer guidance and improvements.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with our sales, marketing, and fulfillment teams using Slack, ClickUp, and GoHighLevel to ensure a seamless client experience.


What We’re Looking For

  • Experience: 2+ years in a client success, account management, or customer service role (preferably in digital marketing, SaaS, or home services industries).
  • Communication Skills:Fluent English speaker with excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Minimal accent for clear and effective communication with U.S.-based clients.
  • Tech-Savvy: Experience using GoHighLevel, Slack, and ClickUp (or similar CRM and project management tools).
  • Comfortable with marketing automation and CRM tools.
  • Problem-Solving: Ability to think critically and proactively address client concerns.
  • Results-Driven: Passionate about helping clients succeed and achieving high retention rates.
  • Organized & Detail-Oriented: Ability to manage multiple clients and tasks efficiently.
  • Faith & Integrity: A commitment to conducting business with the highest ethical standards.


Why Join Marketing Ninjas?

  • Work with a mission-driven team that operates with integrity and excellence.
  • Remote work flexibility – work from anywhere!
  • Opportunities for growth in a fast-paced, ninja-themed marketing agency.
  • Competitive salary + performance-based incentives.
  • Supportive team environment with a strong focus on faith, values, and client success.


Ready to Join the Ninja Squad?

If you’re passionate about helping businesses grow , building strong client relationships , and delivering exceptional service , we’d love to hear from you! Apply today and become part of the Marketing Ninjas team.


To move forward with your application, please complete this short form:

Apply here:

title: ANALISTA PROCESSOS REGULATORIOS JR
description:
Descrição da vaga

Nós somos a Cogna, a maior e mais completa empresa de serviços educacionais do país.

Com quase 60 anos de história e mais de 60 marcas, atuamos de forma ampla e integrada, com soluções para escolas, governos e estudantes dos 2 aos 100 anos.

Entre nossas marcas estão Anglo, Red Balloon e Anhanguera, além das editoras Ática, Saraiva, Scipione, que refletem a diversidade e a força do nosso ecossistema educacional.

Contamos com mais de 26 mil colaboradores e o nosso propósito é claro: oferecer soluções educacionais que impulsionam pessoas e organizações a construírem uma melhor versão de si.

Quer fazer parte de um time que inova e impacta milhões? Sua jornada começa aqui!



Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista de Processos Regulatórios Jr. para atuar no suporte às rotinas de monitoramento regulatório e organização de informações estratégicas da companhia. A pessoa será responsável por apoiar o controle e atualização de dados, garantindo conformidade e visibilidade dos processos regulatórios para a gestão.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

• Realizar o monitoramento e atualização de controles em Excel, garantindo a organização e confiabilidade das informações.

• Apoiar na gestão e manutenção de aplicações em Power Apps utilizadas pela área.

• Atualizar e alimentar painéis e relatórios de indicadores, assegurando a visibilidade dos processos regulatórios.

• Acompanhar e registrar novas portarias, normas e legislações, mantendo as bases de dados atualizadas.

• Dar suporte técnico e operacional ao time, auxiliando na interpretação de informações regulatórias e organização de documentos.

• Contribuir para a organização de dados e informações sensíveis, garantindo precisão, segurança e rastreabilidade.

• Apoiar na preparação de documentações e materiais para auditorias, diligências ou visitas regulatórias.

• Eventualmente, poderá participar de viagens para suporte em atividades da área.


Requisitos e qualificações

• Organização e atenção a detalhes no tratamento de dados e informações.

• Conhecimento ou familiaridade com Excel (controles e bases de dados).

• Experiência ou interesse em Power Apps e gestão de indicadores/painéis será considerado um diferencial.

• Boa comunicação e capacidade de trabalho colaborativo.


Informações adicionais

O que você pode esperar da gente?

  • Participação nos lucros: resultados com comemoração fazem parte do jeito Cogna.
  • Vale-refeição ou alimentação: num cartão de benefícios flexível.
  • Assistência médica: um abrangente plano de saúde, com inclusão de dependentes e coparticipação.
  • Assistência odontológica: está disponível para manter seu sorriso.


Mas espera, ainda tem mais!

  • Bolsas de estudo de graduação e pós graduação: nossas unidades de ensino para que você e seus dependentes (cônjuge e filhos).
  • Day off no aniversário: você poderá escolher um dia para relaxar e celebrar.
  • Convênio SESC: abre as portas para as inúmeras oportunidades de melhora na qualidade de vida.
  • Convênio farmácia Univers: descontos numa variedade de medicamentos.
  • Universidade corporativa: diversas trilhas e cursos gratuitos na nossa universidade corporativa para você seguir evoluindo com a gente.
  • Descontos em livros: para você adquirir os melhores títulos em nossas editoras.
  • Wellhub (Gympass): para que você possa se movimentar no seu dia a dia.
  • Programa Ninho: Um programa dedicado às nossas famílias que estão aguardando um novo bebê.
  • Valoriza - Programa de Recrutamento Interno: Para impulsionar sua carreira por meio de oportunidades internas.



Aqui, acreditamos no respeito, na diversidade e na busca da inclusão em todas suas frentes. Todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados independentemente de raça, gênero, identidade, expressão de gênero, orientação sexual, nacionalidade, genética, deficiência ou de qualquer outra base.

Nosso propósito é avançar cada vez mais, gerando empregabilidade para talentos diversos. Venha enriquecer nosso time!

title: .Net Software Engineer
description:
Avenue Code is the leading software consultancy focused on delivering end-to-end development solutions for digital transformation across every vertical. We’re privately held, profitable, and have been on a solid growth trajectory since day one. We care deeply about our clients, our partners, and our people. We prefer the word ‘partner’ over ‘vendor’, and our investment in professional relationships is a reflection of that philosophy. We pride ourselves on our technical acumen, our collaborative problem-solving ability, and the warm professionalism of our teams.


Avenue Code has been believing in and promoting plurality actions for over 10 years, understanding that recognizing differences and fostering a safe environment, employment opportunities, representation, and support are the best ways to promote an increasingly equitable culture.


We are looking for a Backend Developer to join our team and support the development, maintenance, and evolution of services and APIs that power our digital applications and products. This role requires someone who is passionate about building scalable, secure, and high-performance backend solutions and collaborating within an agile environment.


A key part of this role will be validating the end-to-end orchestration of automated automotive payment scenarios using external APIs in a controlled environment. The proof of concept will demonstrate deterministic orchestration, rule-based evaluation, integration with third-party APIs, and the generation of non-binding scenarios through an AI interface.

Fluent English is essential, as the role involves close collaboration with international stakeholders.


Key Responsibilities

  • Develop, maintain, and evolve backend services and APIs that support digital platforms and applications
  • Validate end-to-end orchestration of automated automotive payment scenarios using external APIs
  • Contribute to proof-of-concept initiatives involving deterministic orchestration and rule-based evaluation
  • Integrate backend services with third-party APIs and external platforms
  • Build scalable and reliable backend systems following established best practices and architectural standards
  • Collaborate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies, including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, and retrospectives
  • Implement unit tests and ensure quality through proper testing and integration practices
  • Work closely with cross-functional teams including product, QA, and engineering


Required Qualifications

  • Strong experience in backend development
  • Proficiency in C#
  • Experience with SQL databases and relational database design
  • Experience with NoSQL databases, particularly MongoDB
  • Knowledge of API development and integration
  • Experience writing and maintaining unit tests
  • Familiarity with Agile methodologies, particularly Scrum
  • Fluent English (spoken and written)

description:
Avenue Code is the leading software consultancy focused on delivering end-to-end development solutions for digital transformation across every vertical. We’re privately held, profitable, and have been on a solid growth trajectory since day one. We care deeply about our clients, our partners, and our people. We prefer the word ‘partner’ over ‘vendor’, and our investment in professional relationships is a reflection of that philosophy. We pride ourselves on our technical acumen, our collaborative problem-solving ability, and the warm professionalism of our teams.


Avenue Code has been believing in and promoting plurality actions for over 10 years, understanding that recognizing differences and fostering a safe environment, employment opportunities, representation, and support are the best ways to promote an increasingly equitable culture.


We are looking for a Backend Developer to join our team and support the development, maintenance, and evolution of services and APIs that power our digital applications and products. This role requires someone who is passionate about building scalable, secure, and high-performance backend solutions and collaborating within an agile environment.


A key part of this role will be validating the end-to-end orchestration of automated automotive payment scenarios using external APIs in a controlled environment. The proof of concept will demonstrate deterministic orchestration, rule-based evaluation, integration with third-party APIs, and the generation of non-binding scenarios through an AI interface.

Fluent English is essential, as the role involves close collaboration with international stakeholders.


Key Responsibilities

  • Develop, maintain, and evolve backend services and APIs that support digital platforms and applications
  • Validate end-to-end orchestration of automated automotive payment scenarios using external APIs
  • Contribute to proof-of-concept initiatives involving deterministic orchestration and rule-based evaluation
  • Integrate backend services with third-party APIs and external platforms
  • Build scalable and reliable backend systems following established best practices and architectural standards
  • Collaborate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies, including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, and retrospectives
  • Implement unit tests and ensure quality through proper testing and integration practices
  • Work closely with cross-functional teams including product, QA, and engineering


Required Qualifications

  • Strong experience in backend development
  • Proficiency in C#
  • Experience with SQL databases and relational database design
  • Experience with NoSQL databases, particularly MongoDB
  • Knowledge of API development and integration
  • Experience writing and maintaining unit tests
  • Familiarity with Agile methodologies, particularly Scrum
  • Fluent English (spoken and written)

title: Senior React Native Engineer - Remote - Talent Pool
description:
About the Role

We’re building a talent pool for Senior React Native Engineers . This pipeline role is for engineers with strong experience, skilled in building high-performance, scalable mobile systems , and following best practices for architecture, performance, and maintainability.


What You’ll Do

- Build and maintain high-performance mobile apps using React Native and TypeScript.

- Design app architecture and manage state, navigation, and offline workflows.

- Integrate native iOS/Android modules and platform-specific features.

- Optimize performance and ensure maintainable, secure code.

- Collaborate with backend and product teams, contributing to technical decisions and releases.


What We’re Looking For

- 5+ years of React Native experience.

- Strong proficiency TypeScript and modern state management libraries (Redux, Zustand, Recoil, or equivalent ).

- Deep understanding of mobile app architecture : navigation, performance tuning, offline-first workflows, and background tasks.

- Experience with native iOS/Android modules (bridging, push notifications, secure storage).

- Proven ability to design and deliver apps that meet security and compliance standards (secure data storage, encryption, RBAC).

- Familiarity with CI/CD for mobile and release processes for App Store/Google Play.

- Excellent communication skills, able to collaborate across backend, DevOps, and product teams.

- Prior experience contributing to technical decision-making and architecture discussions.


Nice to Have

- Familiarity with GCP, Firebase, or mobile analytics frameworks.

- Experience building cross-platform libraries or contributing to open-source React Native projects.

- Hands-on work with GraphQL and secure API integrations.

- Understanding of mobile accessibility (WCAG) and performance monitoring tools.


Why Join Kake?

Kake is a remote-first company with a global community — fully believing that it’s not where your table is, but what you bring to the table that matters. We provide top-tier engineering teams to support some of the world’s most innovative companies, and we’ve built a culture where great people stay, grow, and thrive. We’re proud to be more than just a stop along the way in your career — we’re the destination.


The icing on the Kake:

Competitive Pay in USD – Work globally, get paid globally.

Fully Remote – Simply put, we trust you.

Better Me Fund – We invest in your personal growth and passions.

❤️ Compassion is Badass – Join a community that invests in social good.

title: Senior iOS Engineer - Remote - Talent Pool
description:
About the Role

We’re building a talent pool for Senior iOS Engineers . This pipeline role is for engineers with strong experience, skilled in building high-performance, scalable mobile systems , and following best practices for architecture, performance, and maintainability.


What You’ll Do

- Build and maintain high-performance, scalable iOS applications using Swift (and Objective-C when applicable).

- Design app architecture following MVVM, MVC, VIPER, or Clean Architecture patterns.

- Integrate iOS platform features, including UIKit, SwiftUI, Core Data, push notifications, background tasks, and sensors.

- Collaborate with product, design, and backend teams to define, implement, and deliver new features.

- Optimize app performance, concurrency, and responsiveness, ensuring stability and reliability.

- Contribute to technical decisions, code reviews, and continuous improvement of iOS development practices.


What We’re Looking For

- 7+ years of professional iOS development experience.

- Strong proficiency in Swift ; experience with Objective-C is a plus.

- Deep understanding of iOS frameworks (UIKit, SwiftUI, Foundation, Core Data ).

- Solid knowledge of mobile application architecture patterns (MVVM, MVC, VIPER, Clean Architecture).

- Experience working with RESTful APIs and parsing JSON; familiarity with GraphQL is a bonus.

- Understanding of concurrency and multithreading (GCD, Operations).

- Experience with unit and UI testing frameworks (XCTest, XCUITest).

- Proficiency with Git and common branching strategies.

- Proven ability to deliver high-quality, maintainable code within project timelines.


Nice To Have

- Experience with cross-platform development (React Native, Flutter) or multi-module iOS projects.

- Hands-on experience with analytics frameworks, CI/CD pipelines, or mobile performance monitoring tools.

description:

Long-term contract

Remote

Senior Fullstack Engineer

What You Get To Do Every Day

- Produce high-quality, performant, and testable code that directly contributes to company-wide initiatives

- Develop using interesting technologies -- Elixir, Ruby, React, Typescript, GraphQL, Kafka, AWS/Lambda, PostgreSQL, DynamoDB

- Have significant input into technical decisions that will shape the future of our software systems

- Learn something new, whether its a new software design pattern or new initiative to push the company forward

- Review pull requests and provide constructive feedback to your peers - Pair up with a team member to work together on features

- Deploy user-facing code to production

- What You Bring To The Role

title: Content and Social Media Marketing, and Graphic Design Intern
description:
Calling All Awesome Marketing Interns!!!


Are you eager to learn and gain hands-on experience in Social Media Marketing, Content Marketing, and Graphic Design ? We’re looking for a motivated apprentice to join our team and help us create engaging content that connects with our audience.


The program is a 3-month remote internship , during which you will assist in fulfilling various digital marketing tasks for your mentioned business for 10 hours per week. This is an unpaid program whose end goal is to provide students with a higher chance of getting hired in the digital marketing space after completing our apprenticeship program.


What’s In It For You?

  • It’s (100%) fully remote position and offers flexibility in schedule.
  • You’ll have clear goals and the training resources you need to deliver.
  • Access our free courses on the platform that you can finish at your own pace.
  • 1 to 2 hours of mentorship every week.
  • Issued certification upon successfully completing the program.
  • Boost your portfolio and grow your professional network
  • Get to utilize and elevate your digital marketing skills in real projects
  • You have a high chance of being hired by your mentor during or after the apprenticeship, depending on your performance.


What You’ll Do:

  • Assist in creating engaging content for social media, blogs, newsletters, and campaigns
  • Support the design team with graphics, layouts, and visual assets
  • Help manage social media platforms and support community engagement
  • Contribute to PR initiatives, including drafting press releases and coordinating with media partners
  • Brainstorm fresh ideas for brand awareness and digital campaigns
  • Support administrative and marketing tasks as needed


What We’re Looking For:

  • Background or strong interest in Marketing, Communications, Graphic Design, PR, or related fields
  • Basic knowledge of content writing and social media strategy
  • Skills in graphic design tools (Canva, Adobe Creative Suite, or similar)
  • Strong communication skills (written and verbal)
  • Creative mindset with a keen eye for detail
  • Ability to work independently and meet deadlines


About us:

Acadium started with the belief that anyone, anywhere, should be able to get the skills and experience they need to start their career without barriers like price, schedule, or location getting in their way. Acadium gives anyone the tools, support, and mentorship they need to launch their dream career. Acadium is the only platform that provides real work experience, accessible to everyone. Acadium began in 2017 with a team of 3 co-founders: Richard Shaw, Marco Tundo, and Moe Abbas. Since then, they’ve attracted more than 120,000 student members and over 50,000 businesses to connect through the apprenticeship marketplace. Our team is growing and looking for people who are motivated, intelligent, and committed to making education accessible to join our team.


What We Value:

  • Integrity - Be trustworthy in your actions
  • Care - Treat your teammates and our community as you would want to be treated
  • Curiosity - Ask questions. Always state your assumptions
  • Tenacity - Persevere when times are tough
  • Discipline - Be consistent in your actions
  • Ambition - Aspire to become better every day
  • Service -Serve your community to the best of your abilities.

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description:
We are looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer to help build, evolve, and operate our cloud infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, and production environments. We are seeking a professional with strong experience in automation, container orchestration, and scalable infrastructure.


What You’ll Do

• Design, build, and maintain scalable cloud infrastructure

• Develop and optimize CI/CD pipelines for reliable deployments

• Operate and troubleshoot Kubernetes environments in production

• Improve observability, monitoring, and system reliability practices

• Collaborate with engineering teams to support services and microservices architectures


Requirements

• 7+ years of experience in DevOps, SRE, or Infrastructure Engineering

• Strong experience with Kubernetes (deployment, operations, and troubleshooting)

• Experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP)

• Experience with observability tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, Tempo, or Loki

• Experience with CI/CD pipeline automation (GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or similar)

• Experience with Rust (development, tooling, or integration with services)

• Solid knowledge of Linux, networking, and cloud security best practices

• Technical English proficiency (reading and writing)

• Strong communication and teamwork skills


Nice to Have

• Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Pulumi, or similar)

• Experience with Apache Kafka

• PostgreSQL and Redis in production environments

• Docker and container orchestration in production

• Experience with microservices architecture and APIs (REST/gRPC)

• Experience troubleshooting production environments, on-call rotations, and post-mortems

• Familiarity with DevSecOps practices


If you thrive in an innovative and collaborative environment and want to be part of a company building high-performance technology infrastructure, we would love to hear from you.

title: SAP Basis Consultant
description:
Analista PL / Consultor SAP Basis



Responsabilidades:


1. Fornecer suporte técnico avançado, aderindo aos padrões de qualidade e requisitos regulamentares, garantindo a conformidade com as políticas da empresa nos ambientes SAP Basis e SAP HANA DB.

2. Resolver incidentes complexos escalados por analistas, realizando análises de causa raiz completas e implementando soluções eficazes para resolver problemas técnicos e de segurança.

3. Facilitar a transferência de conhecimento, atualizando e gerenciando a base de conhecimento, treinando novos membros da equipe e orientando analistas para aprimorar as capacidades da equipe.

4. Gerenciar e resolver chamados complexos dentro dos SLAs acordados, colaborando com equipes de suporte multifuncionais para manter a eficiência operacional e garantir uma postura de segurança robusta.

5. Aprimorar a experiência do cliente, alcançando altas taxas de resolução no primeiro contato, minimizando resoluções rejeitadas e reaberturas de casos, enquanto mitiga proativamente as ameaças à segurança.


Requisitos:

  • Inglês avançado. - boa comunicação, participação em chamadas, etc. (OBRIGATÓRIO)
  • Sólido conhecimento do pacote de soluções SAP e arquitetura técnica, com capacidade de traduzir desafios de negócios.
  • 4. Fortes habilidades de consultoria e gestão de stakeholders – habilidades demonstráveis de apresentação, consultoria voltada para o cliente e influência até o nível executivo (C-suite). Todos os candidatos devem ser assertivos e articulados, com capacidade de desenvolver e manter relacionamentos com clientes de alto nível.
  • 5. Compreensão da estratégia de produto da SAP, incluindo o posicionamento do S/4HANA e ferramentas de habilitação e tecnologias complementares, especialmente a integração com outros aplicativos.
  • 6. Bom conhecimento das ofertas de nuvem pública GCP, AWS e Azure e arquitetura de soluções.

title: Direct Response Video Editor
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Build the creative engine behind performance.

Portent Brands is a holding company scaling a portfolio of healthcare and ecommerce brands through performance creative and paid growth. We build brands that win at the unit economics level—and great creative is central to how we do it.


As our DTC Video Editor, you’ll own the full lifecycle of paid video creative across Meta, TikTok, YouTube, and Google. You’ll work directly with our Creative Lead and Head of Growth—taking briefs from concept to final ad independently, then iterating fast based on what the data says.


This isn’t a brand-only role. Performance, output velocity, and creative precision are the metrics that matter here. You’ll use AI tools to compress production timelines, leverage motion design to elevate hooks, and bring a direct-response instinct to every cut.


Over time, you’ll become a core creative engine across Growth, CRO, and Product—shaping how our brands convert at scale.


WHAT YOU’LL DO

Own the output. Drive the numbers.

  • DTC Video Editing: Edit and ship conversion-focused video ads for Meta, TikTok, YouTube, and Google. Every cut has a performance objective.
  • Motion Design: Build sharp animations and motion graphics that reinforce hooks, brand identity, and storytelling clarity.
  • Creative Variations: Produce fast, high-quality iterations across hooks, angles, formats, pacing, and lengths to fuel continuous testing.
  • AI-Powered Production: Actively use AI video, voice, image, and asset generation tools to move from concept to finished ad in hours—not days.
  • Data-Driven Editing: Review performance metrics (thumb-stop rate, hold rate, CTR, ROAS) and translate insights directly into creative decisions.
  • A/B Testing: Run structured creative experiments and iterate quickly based on results.
  • Optimization: Continuously sharpen pacing, copy overlays, hooks, captions, structure, sound design, and visual clarity.
  • Trend Awareness: Stay current on paid social trends, platform best practices, and emerging editing and AI tools.


WHAT YOU BRING

Skills that ship.

  • Experience: 3+ years editing high-performing DTC paid social ads. Strong portfolio of Meta and TikTok creatives required.
  • Editing Tools: Expert in Adobe Premiere Pro, Capcut, Davinci Resolve. Solid working knowledge of After Effects and Photoshop.
  • Motion Design: Strong command of animation, typography, transitions, sound design, pacing, color, and visual storytelling.
  • Performance Mindset: You understand what makes a direct-response ad work—hooks, clarity, messaging hierarchy, pacing, and CTA structure.
  • AI Fluency: Comfortable using AI tools daily as part of your production stack, not as a novelty.
  • Output Velocity: Able to manage multiple edits simultaneously, hit deadlines, and sustain high-quality output at scale.
  • Captions & Copy: Writes and applies accurate, compelling English captions that reinforce messaging and hooks.
  • Execution: Takes a brief to final cut independently. Moves fast without losing craft.
  • Ownership: Finds what’s missing, fixes it, and keeps work moving without being asked.
  • Collaboration: Works fluidly with the team. Takes direct feedback and turns it around fast.
  • AI Video Tools: Hands-on experience with AI-native video editing or automation tools.
  • Creative Strategy: Familiarity with direct-response creative frameworks, hook testing, and angle development.
  • Industry: Experience with DTC, healthcare, wellness, or weight-loss brands.
  • High-Volume Teams: Background in high-throughput creative environments where output volume is tied directly to performance.


NICE TO HAVE

Bonus points.

  • Industry: Experience with DTC, healthcare, wellness, or weight-loss brands.


Compensation:

  • Base salary of $1,250 per month.
  • Performance incentive based on creative performance
  • OTE $5,000 per month

title: Brand & Copy Strategist
description:
Hey, Dingus!


Yep—you read that right. Dingus & Zazzy is expanding, and we’re on the hunt for a Brand & Copy Strategist!


About Us


Dingus & Zazzy is a global digital marketing agency helping brands grow across every corner of the digital landscape. We offer an “unlimited get-shit-done” subscription for our clients—from websites to social to SEO and everything in between.


Our team is full of creatives, strategists, tech geeks, and builders who love making brands look, feel, and perform better online. If that sounds like your vibe, keep reading.


Purpose of This Position


As a Brand & Copy Strategist, you are responsible for writing and owning all copy for the clients within your squad, ensuring that every word reflects the brand’s voice, positioning, and intent.

You ensure that every piece of written content across websites, social media, email, and campaigns is on-brand, intentional, and delivered at a high standard. You bring together copywriting, brand awareness, practical content direction, strategy, and project management to ensure brands are represented clearly and consistently through words.


You act as the bridge between brand intent and execution, translating client goals and direction into clear, purposeful copy that is ready for internal review and client delivery.


Core Responsibility


Serve as the owner of brand representation through copy for your squad’s clients. Your accountability is defined by the following questions:

  • “Is this copy clear, on-brand, purposeful, and strong enough to confidently move forward?”
  • \"Is this project timeline possible with the resources we have for proper execution?”


Main Objectives


1. Content Execution & Copywriting

  • Write high-quality, purpose-driven copy for:
  • -Websites
  • -Social media captions and post copy
  • -Email campaigns
  • -Campaign and promotional assets
  • Design-related copy (headlines, CTAs, supporting text)
  • Act as the primary writer for all copy deliverables within your squad.
  • Ensure every piece of copy is written with intention, clarity, and audience awareness.
  • Perform copyediting on your own work to maintain consistency, grammatical excellence, and brand alignment, using tools and peers as needed.


2. Strategy & Project Management

  • Create social media strategies for your clients based on their goals and audiences
  • Keep track of client feedback and apply them to future work
  • Plan content in batches for the month, ensuring:
  • -Consistency in writing style
  • -Variety in content types
  • -A range of related, engaging topics


3. Social Media Copy & Content Direction

  • Develop and write social media copy that reflects the brand’s voice and messaging.
  • When appropriate, define content themes and messaging direction for social platforms.
  • When deeper strategy or clarity is required, collaborate with Special Teams to receive social content strategy support or plans.
  • Execute all social media copy in alignment with the strategy you create and flag any gaps or unclear direction early.


4. Creative Collaboration & Brand Consistency

  • Participate in brainstorming and ideation sessions to help define the content, messaging, and assets required for campaigns and initiatives.
  • Provide copy-led input on creative direction to ensure consistency of brand voice, messaging, and intent across all touchpoints.
  • Collaborate with designers, Marketing Coordinators, and Account Managers to align written and visual assets under a cohesive brand narrative.
  • Contribute perspective beyond copy when needed to maintain brand clarity and consistency.


5. Brand Advocacy

  • Act as the copy owner for each assigned brand, ensuring consistent voice, tone, and messaging across all written content.
  • Apply brand guidelines and positioning directly within copy execution.
  • Review copy deliverables to ensure they meet internal quality standards and accurately represent the brand’s intent.


Reporting Relationship

  • This role reports to the designated Account Manager of your squad.


Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)


1. Brand Alignment & Copy Effectiveness

  • Ensure all copy deliverables are consistently aligned with the brand’s voice, tone, and messaging.
  • Maintain minimal client revisions related to brand alignment, tone, or clarity.
  • Contribute social content ideas and messaging angles when needed, ensuring alignment with the brand’s voice, positioning, and goals.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally to ensure brand consistency across copy and supporting assets.


2. Content Quality & Accuracy

  • Deliver copy that meets internal quality standards for clarity, structure, and purpose.
  • Maintain a low rate of client dissatisfaction related to copy quality or intent.


3. Project Delivery Timeliness

  • Deliver copy-related tasks within agreed timelines.
  • Collaborate with the squad to support smooth handoffs and on-time delivery of content assets.


Work Details

  • Hours: 9 A.M. – 5 P.M. MST, Monday to Friday
  • Requires a working level of written and spoken English


Ready for the ride of your life? Apply now!

title: Graphic Designer
description:
Hey, Dingus!


Yeah, you heard that right.


Dingus & Zazzy is looking for a motivated, ambitious Graphic Designer to join our growing team!


About Us


Dingus & Zazzy is a global digital marketing agency helping brands grow across every corner of the digital landscape. We offer an “unlimited get-shit-done” subscription for our clients—from websites to social to SEO and everything in between.


Our team is full of creatives, strategists, tech geeks, and builders who love making brands look, feel, and perform better online. If that sounds like your vibe, keep reading.


Key Responsibilities


  • Create visually appealing designs for various platforms, including digital, print, social media, and branding.
  • Use AI tools and design software to streamline the design process, generate ideas, and automate repetitive tasks, ensuring fresh and innovative results.
  • Use AI tools (Nanobanana, Freepik AI, Magic Canva Studio) to generate engaging videos and simple animations for social media.
  • Editing videos and creating simple animations for social media use.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (marketing, content, etc.) to deliver high-quality design solutions that align with brand guidelines and project goals.
  • Work on design projects from start to finish, ensuring designs are on-brand, on-time, and meet all requirements.
  • Stay up-to-date with the latest design trends, tools, and AI technologies to keep your work innovative and relevant.
  • Edit and optimize designs for various media, ensuring the best quality and user experience across devices.


Qualifications


  • Strong experience as a graphic designer, with a portfolio showcasing your skills in visual design, creativity, and problem-solving.
  • Proficiency in design software like Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, Premiere), Canva, Figma, or similar tools.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft programs (PowerPoint and Word)
  • Experience working with video editing tools like Premiere, CapCut, and Canva.
  • Familiarity with AI-powered design tools (such as ChatGPT, Gemini, Nanobanana, Midjourney, Firefly, Freepik AI, Claude, etc.) and an eagerness to explore new AI technologies.
  • Understanding of digital design principles for social media, websites, and other online platforms.
  • Understanding of small-scale and large-scale print materials (such as business cards, flyers, menus, conference collateral, merchandise, banners, backdrops, etc.)
  • Ability to work efficiently, meet deadlines, and manage multiple design projects simultaneously.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with team members.
  • A working level of written and spoken English


Our operating hours are 9 A.M. to 5 P.M. MST, Monday to Friday.


Ready for the ride of your life? Apply now!

title: Data Engineer (API)
description:
Role: Data Engineer III (API) or Software Engineer with Data Experience

Location: Mexico / Brazil (Remote)

Mode: Contract/FTE


About the Role

We are looking for a senior-level engineer with strong backend and data expertise. The role centers on Node.js, TypeScript, APIs, and database modeling with exposure to cloud services.


Responsibilities

  • Build and manage APIs (REST & GraphQL).
  • Design and optimize data models (MongoDB, NoSQL, relational).
  • Work on schema design, indexing, and transactions.
  • Develop ETL pipelines and data ingestion workflows.
  • Collaborate on backend architecture with containers and cloud (AWS/OCI).


Requirements

  • 6+ years of software/data engineering experience.
  • Strong skills in Node.js, TypeScript, and database modeling .
  • Experience with GraphQL, MongoDB, and NoSQL.
  • Knowledge of software engineering best practices.
  • Cloud (AWS/OCI) and container experience.
  • Excellent communication skills.


Nice to Have

  • Messaging systems (Kafka, RabbitMQ).
  • Event-driven architecture.

title: Delivery Lead
description:
Required Skills & Experience


5+ years of experience in delivery lead role

Experience delivering data and analytics products in a production environment

Working knowledge of:

• ETL processes and data pipelines

• BI tools such as Power BI or Tableau

Strong communication skills with the ability to translate between business, product, and engineering teams

Demonstrated ability to identify issues early and escalate effectively


Nice to Have Skills & Experience


Experience supporting logistics, transportation, or pricing analytics initiatives

Background working with Azure-based data ecosystems

Familiarity with database backends and data modeling concepts

Experience operating in complex, cross-functional enterprise environments


Job Description


Insight Global is looking to add a Delivery Lead to their client’s Data & Analytics organization. This person will own the end-to-end delivery of logistics and transportation initiatives, ensuring solutions are delivered on time with high quality and operational reliability. They will support and enhance Transportation Management Systems (TMS) and related logistics data products, ensuring business users have accurate, timely data to drive insights into transportation performance, pricing, and KPIs, etc. They will act as a key liaison between business, product, and engineering teams and will be responsible for translating business needs into clear, actionable requirements, identifying gaps in definition, and partnering with Product Managers to clarify scope before work reaches engineering. They will work closely with engineers to provide business context, facilitate effective technical discussions, and proactively identify and escalate risks related to delivery quality and timelines. This role also leads or supports incident management for data, analytics, and logistics systems by triaging issues, determining actionability, collaborating with engineering on resolution, and ensuring incidents are documented and addressed to prevent recurrence. They will support sprint planning, backlog refinement, delivery tracking, and continuous improvement across delivery processes.

title: Consultor Funcional Sênior – Salesforce Field Service
description:
Consultor Funcional Sênior – Salesforce Field Service

Data de Início: Imediata

Tempo de Alocação: Indeterminado

Local de Trabalho: Rio de Janeiro/RJ (100% remoto com visitas eventuais e planejadas ao cliente)

Horário de Trabalho: 9h00 às 1800


*** Modelo remoto com eventuais viagens ao Rio de Janeiro (aproximadamente uma semana a cada 2–3 meses) ***


Área: Salesforce / Transformação Digital / Field Service Management


Visão Geral da Posição

Buscamos um(a) Consultor(a) Funcional Sênior com sólida experiência em Salesforce e forte atuação em projetos de Field Service. Este profissional será responsável por implementar, evoluir e sustentar soluções voltadas à gestão de operações de campo, com foco na otimização de agendas, eficiência operacional e aumento de produtividade das equipes técnicas.


A posição exige perfil consultivo e analítico, capaz de traduzir necessidades de negócio em soluções funcionais estruturadas no ecossistema Salesforce, atuando em ambientes corporativos complexos e de alta criticidade operacional.


O profissional terá interação constante com áreas de negócio, tecnologia e parceiros, conduzindo análises funcionais, workshops de levantamento de requisitos e garantindo a correta implementação das funcionalidades da plataforma.


Principais Responsabilidades

• Atuar como consultor funcional sênior em iniciativas de melhoria contínua e sustentação de soluções Salesforce Field Service.

• Levantar, analisar e documentar requisitos de negócio relacionados à operação de Field Service e gestão de equipes de campo.

• Configurar e evoluir funcionalidades da plataforma, incluindo Service Territories, Work Orders, Service Appointments e Work Types.

• Definir e implementar regras de agendamento, políticas de scheduling e mecanismos de otimização de rotas e agendas.

• Atuar na integração do Salesforce Field Service com outros módulos da plataforma e sistemas corporativos.

• Conduzir workshops funcionais com áreas de negócio para entendimento de processos operacionais e identificação de oportunidades de melhoria.

• Elaborar documentação funcional, especificações e fluxos de processo relacionados às soluções implementadas.

• Apoiar testes funcionais, homologação e implantação de novas funcionalidades.

• Garantir alinhamento entre requisitos de negócio, arquitetura da solução e boas práticas da plataforma Salesforce.

• Atuar em projetos com alta volumetria operacional e ambientes com múltiplas integrações.


Competências Técnicas Requeridas

• Experiência sólida em Salesforce, com atuação em projetos de implementação e evolução da plataforma.

• Conhecimento aprofundado do Salesforce Field Service.

• Experiência com os seguintes componentes da solução: Service Territories, Work Orders, Service Appointments, Work Types, Scheduling Policies, mecanismos de Optimization e Dispatch.

• Experiência na modelagem de processos operacionais de Field Service.

• Conhecimento em integração de Salesforce com sistemas corporativos.

• Experiência em levantamento de requisitos e documentação funcional de soluções.

• Capacidade de análise de processos operacionais complexos e definição de melhorias sistêmicas.


Diferenciais

• Certificação Salesforce Administrator.

• Certificação Salesforce Field Service Consultant.

• Experiência em projetos nos setores de utilities e commodities (energia, gás, água ou telecomunicações).

• Vivência em ambientes regulados ou operações de campo com grande escala operacional.



Formação

• Ensino superior completo em Tecnologia da Informação, Engenharia, Administração ou áreas correlatas.


Experiência

• Experiência comprovada como Consultor Funcional Sênior em projetos Salesforce.

• Atuação prática em projetos envolvendo Salesforce Field Service.


Maiores detalhes serão fornecidos durante a entrevista técnica com o cliente.

title: [Tech] Arquitetura de Dados
description:
Atuar na arquitetura, construção e evolução do Data Lake e dos produtos de dados desenvolvidos pelo time, incluindo soluções de Analytics, agentes e modelos de machine learning.


Trabalhará em conjunto com o especialista de engenharia de dados na definição e implementação de arquiteturas, modelagem e disponibilização de dados em ambientes distribuídos, utilizando tecnologias como AWS, Spark, Trino e Athena, além de viabilizar o consumo eficiente dessas informações por ferramentas como o Metabase.


Será responsável por desenvolver e otimizar pipelines de dados, garantindo performance, escalabilidade, qualidade e governança das informações. Espera-se que o profissional atue com alta autonomia técnica, contribuindo para decisões de arquitetura e para a evolução contínua do ecossistema de dados, assegurando que as soluções atendam às necessidades analíticas e de inteligência dos produtos com robustez e confiabilidade.


O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER:

  • Atuar na construção e evolução da arquitetura do Data Lake e dos produtos de dados do time (Analytics, agentes e modelos);
  • Desenvolver, otimizar e manter pipelines de dados escaláveis e confiáveis em ambiente AWS;
  • Modelar e estruturar dados para consumo analítico e operacional, garantindo qualidade, performance e governança;
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com o especialista de engenharia na definição de padrões, arquiteturas e boas práticas de dados;
  • Implementar e otimizar consultas e camadas de acesso a dados utilizando Athena e Trino;
  • Processar e transformar grandes volumes de dados utilizando Spark;
  • Garantir a disponibilização eficiente de datasets para consumo em ferramentas analíticas como Metabase;
  • Monitorar, diagnosticar e otimizar o desempenho de pipelines, queries e tabelas no Data Lake;
  • Assegurar qualidade, integridade e rastreabilidade dos dados ao longo de todo o pipeline;
  • Apoiar a definição de estratégias de particionamento, versionamento e organização de dados;
  • Contribuir com a documentação técnica e evolução das boas práticas de engenharia de dados;
  • Acompanhar tendências e propor melhorias contínuas no ecossistema de dados e nas tecnologias


O QUE ESPERAMOS DE VOCÊ:

  • Graduação completa em Engenharia, Ciência da Computação, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência sólida em engenharia de dados, construção e manutenção de pipelines de dados em larga escala;
  • Domínio de SQL avançado para manipulação e otimização de grandes volumes de dados;
  • Experiência prática com processamento distribuído utilizando Spark;
  • Experiência com serviços de dados na AWS (ex: S3, Glue, Athena, IAM, entre outros);
  • Experiência com engines de consulta distribuída, como Athena e/ou Trino;
  • Conhecimento em infraestrutura como Código (Terraform)
  • Experiência em streaming de dados em tempo real (Apache Kafka)
  • Conhecimento em bancos relacionais (PostgreSQL), não relacionais (MongoDB) e vetoriais (Milvus, Pinecone, S3 Vector)
  • Experiência em governança de dados (Apache Ranger)
  • Conhecimento em Data lake/lakehouse moderno (Iceberg, PyIceberg)
  • Conhecimento em boas práticas de qualidade, governança e organização de dados;
  • Experiência trabalhando em conjunto com times multidisciplinares (dados, produto e engenharia);
  • Capacidade de estruturar soluções de dados escaláveis e de alta performance.


SERIA LEGAL SE TIVESSE:

  • Experiência com disponibilização de dados para ferramentas de BI, como Metabase, Power BI ou Tableau;
  • Vivência com otimização de queries e particionamento de tabelas em Data Lake;
  • Experiência com orquestração de pipelines (ex: Airflow ou similares);
  • Conhecimento em arquitetura de Data Lake;
  • Experiência prévia suportando times de Ciência de Dados e Machine Learning;
  • Conhecimento em práticas de DataOps e observabilidade de pipelines;
